full_list.title_en: Sustainability-Aware Discovery of Dual-Atom Hydrogen Evolution Catalysts via a Unified Machine Learning Framework for Activity and Carbon Cost
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Sustainability-Aware Discovery of Dual-Atom Hydrogen Evolution Catalysts via a Unified Machine Learning Framework for Activity and Carbon Cost
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2605.29821v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Catalyst discovery for green hydrogen has optimized activity alone, deferring economic and environmental costs to stages where they disqualify otherwise promising candidates. Here we introduce a unified machine learning framework that screens catalytic activity and monetized carbon cost in a single pipeline. A machine learning potential predicts hydrogen evolution activity and stability at density-functional-theory accuracy. A second model, trained on published estimates of the social cost of carbon, converts each candidate's embodied CO2 into a monetary burden. Screening 460 graphene-supported dual-atom catalysts across 23 transition metals and 20 nitrogen-coordination motifs yields 26 active, synthesizable candidates. The two axes then conflict. The most active candidates span Mn-, Fe-, Zr-, Cr-, Cu-, Ni-, Ti-, Nb-, V-, Pd-, Au-, and Rh-based catalysts, indistinguishable in adsorption energy yet spanning a 58,000-fold range in carbon cost. Joint optimization selects Mn2@2Nf and Zr2@2Nc, matching the best precious-metal activity at tens-of-thousands-fold lower carbon cost, independent of catalyst loading.

full_list.title_en: Robust high-fidelity three-qubit gates design for superconducting quantum computers via model-free reinforcement learning
full_list.title_zh: 通过无模型强化学习为超导量子计算机设计鲁棒的高保真三量子位门
full_list.abstract: Multi-qubit gates are crucial to realizing quantum algorithms. Direct implementation of these gates will facilitate a reduction in circuit depth. However, existing model-based methods rely on precise characterization of the system Hamiltonian as well as execution of the control fields, which present challenges in obtaining high fidelity multi-qubit gates. In this paper, we exploit the bang–bang control protocol and model-free reinforcement learning to realize several kinds of three-qubit gates for superconducting quantum computers with tunable/fixed frequency qubits, including the iToffoli gate, the parity check gate and the CCZ gate. The simulation results show that the fidelity of each gate can achieve 99.2% with the Adam gradient descent optimizer. Moreover, the proposed method is robust against random noise in the control pulse. Gate fidelity can be maintained over 95% even in the case of Gaussian noise with variance of 0.3. Besides, the impacts of parameter iterative optimization strategies are also analyzed.
full_list.abstract_zh: 多量子位门对于实现量子算法至关重要。直接实现这些门将有助于减少电路深度。然而，现有的基于模型的方法依赖于系统哈密顿量的精确表征以及控制场的执行，这对获得高保真多量子位门提出了挑战。在本文中，我们利用bang-bang控制协议和无模型强化学习，为具有可调谐/固定频率量子位的超导量子计算机实现了几种三量子位门，包括iToffoli门、奇偶校验门和CCZ门。仿真结果表明，采用Adam梯度下降优化器，每个门的保真度可以达到99.2%。

full_list.title_en: Machine learning enabled design of sustainable alloys considering real world constraints
full_list.title_zh: 机器学习支持考虑现实世界限制的可持续合金设计
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.35946v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Designing sustainable alloys must reconcile high performance with real-world constraints, including feedstock scarcity and variability, processing and energy requirements, regulatory thresholds, and economic limitations. Addressing these constraints reaches far beyond today's conventional performance-focused frameworks. It needs to consider not only complex property-processing-performance trade-offs but also sustainable production pathways. Here, we propose a physics-informed ensemble (PIE) learning framework that integrates fundamental structure-property relationships with processing routes and sustainability criteria for mechanism-based alloy design. It predicts properties from composition-microstructure relationships and infers processing routes under sustainability constraints, establishing an interdisciplinary approach to identifying sustainable alloy solutions. We validate the approach for Mg alloys, a lightweight yet energy-intensive metallic material class, considering performance, cost, and carbon emissions. Trained on a benchmark dataset, the PIE model systematically explores plausible alloy compositions and microstructures to construct a digital library of millions of candidate alloys. From this space, we identify two sustainable Mg alloy solutions that overcome the conventional performance-cost-emission trade-off: a rare-earth-containing alloy increases yield and tensile strength by 72.8 percent and 61.1 percent, respectively, over alloys from the same family at comparable cost and emissions; and a rare-earth-free alloy reduces cost and carbon emissions by 40.4 percent and 88.9 percent, respectively, relative to its primary-feedstock counterpart, without compromising mechanical performance. This work introduces a general, physics-informed, and quantifiable framework for designing sustainable alloys under real-world constraints.
full_list.abstract_zh: 设计可持续合金必须协调高性能与现实世界的限制，包括原料稀缺性和可变性、加工和能源要求、监管阈值和经济限制。解决这些限制远远超出了当今传统的以性能为中心的框架的范围。它不仅需要考虑复杂的财产-加工-性能权衡，还需要考虑可持续的生产途径。在这里，我们提出了一种物理信息集成（PIE）学习框架，它将基本结构-性能关系与基于机制的合金设计的加工路线和可持续性标准相结合。它根据成分-微观结构关系预测性能，并推断可持续性约束下的加工路线，建立跨学科方法来识别可持续合金解决方案。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 设计可持续合金必须协调高性能与现实世界的限制，包括原料稀缺性和可变性、加工和能源要求、监管阈值和经济限制。解决这些限制远远超出了当今传统的以性能为中心的框架的范围。它不仅需要考虑复杂的财产-加工-性能权衡，还需要考虑可持续的生产途径。在这里，我们提出了一种物理信息集成（PIE）学习框架，它将基本结构-性能关系与基于机制的合金设计的加工路线和可持续性标准相结合。它根据成分-微观结构关系预测性能，并推断可持续性约束下的加工路线，建立跨学科方法来识别可持续合金解决方案。我们验证了镁合金（一种轻质但能源密集型金属材料类别）的方法，同时考虑了性能、成本和碳排放。 PIE 模型在基准数据集上进行训练，系统地探索合理的合金成分和微观结构，以构建包含数百万种候选合金的数字库。从这个领域，我们确定了两种可持续的镁合金解决方案，克服了传统的性能-成本-排放权衡：与成本和排放相当的同类合金相比，含稀土合金的产量和抗拉强度分别提高了 72.8% 和 61.1%；与主要原料相比，不含稀土的合金可分别降低成本和碳排放 40.4% 和 88.9%，且不会影响机械性能。这项工作介绍了一个通用的、基于物理的、可量化的框架，用于在现实世界的限制下设计可持续合金。

full_list.title_en: Machine Learning Hamiltonians with Polarizations for Heterogeneous Systems
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Machine Learning Hamiltonians with Polarizations for Heterogeneous Systems
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36839v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning Hamiltonians use local atomic structures to determine local Hamiltonian matrix elements without carrying out self-consistent calculations. They have been used to study large systems and to carry out high-throughput screening for their electronic and optical properties. The prediction of the Hamiltonian is essentially the prediction of the electron electrostatic potential energy; however, for heterogeneous systems, this potential energy is often determined by faraway features, such as interface or surface dipoles, or even an applied voltage in a nanodevice. Thus, it cannot be determined by local atomic structures alone. In this sense, one needs to solve the electron electrostatic potential energy self-consistently using intrinsic atomic dipoles, the applied external potential energy, and polarizabilities. Fortunately, the intrinsic dipoles and polarizabilities are local properties, whereas the applied potential energy is a prescribed input. In this work, we propose DeepH-Polar, a physically informed machine learning Hamiltonian model that explicitly predicts intrinsic atomic dipoles and polarizability tensors and uses them to solve the electron electrostatic potential energy self-consistently. Benchmarks on polar GaN systems and crystalline-Si/amorphous-SiO₂ interfaces demonstrate improved Hamiltonian accuracy and reproduction of thickness-dependent electrostatic variations, as well as spatially nonuniform field-induced screening that models without polarization fail to capture. Our model also allows us to study nanoscale electronic devices. By iteratively solving the Hamiltonian eigenproblem and self-consistently updating free-carrier occupations and the electrostatic potential, we simulate an 8,194-atom gated semiconductor device.

full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36155v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a proof-of-principle study demonstrating a conditional generative foundation model for self-organizing magnetized plasma turbulence. Built on a multichannel flow-matching framework with a spectral decomposition strategy, the model is trained on direct numerical simulations of 2D modified Hasegawa-Wakatani (MHW) turbulence across the hydrodynamic to adiabatic parameter range. Without retraining, this single model successfully performs three distinct downstream tasks: (i) unconditional generation of statistically faithful quasi-steady-state snapshots that recover the directional energy spectra and amplitude statistics, from which statistical transport quantities, including turbulent flux and effective diffusivity, alongside their uncertainties, are inferred directly; (ii) super-resolution from 4× and 8× downsampled observations to reconstruct fine-scale turbulence and large-scale zonal structures; and (iii) full-field inpainting from sparse spatial observations covering as little as sim 10% of the domain. The generated fields faithfully reproduce regime-dependent turbulence vs. zonal-flow states and energy partitioning. Under extreme sparsity the long-correlation zonal flows are pinned by only a handful of observations, while the residual uncertainty concentrates in the small-scale turbulent fluctuations. These results establish flow-matching generative models as powerful, unified surrogates for state generation, statistical inference, and sparse-data reconstruction, providing a scalable baseline for 3D plasma turbulence and experimental applications.

full_list.abstract: arXiv:2603.24052v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a system for generating arbitrary, triaxial magnetic waveforms with a spectral content spanning from DC to tens of kHz, a critical capability for quantum control and spin manipulation. To compensate for amplifier-coil dynamics, we implement a data-driven approach to identify a numerical compensation model. The method parametrizes the system response using a Finite Impulse Response (FIR) filter calibrated on the specific waveform to be generated. The application of a driving signal designed via frequency-domain inversion of the identified model enables the synthesis of complex field sequences with sharp transitions between static and single- or multi-frequency temporal segments. The work is validated with experimental results demonstrating waveform fidelity and transient performance, thereby showcasing the precision and feasibility of the method.

full_list.title_en: Walshness: an intrinsic neural-network representability metric for quantum states
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Walshness: an intrinsic neural-network representability metric for quantum states
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.00505v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Neural quantum states (NQS) have emerged as powerful representations of quantum states with rapidly expanding applications across quantum many-body physics. Yet our understanding of when neural networks can efficiently represent physical quantum states remains limited, in part due to the nonlinear parameterization of NQS, the intricate sign structure of quantum states, and the sensitive dependence on basis choice. We introduce Walshness, a complexity metric of a quantum state which quantifies whether it admits a compact neural-network representation. We rigorously prove that a general quantum many-body state admits an efficient NQS representation if it has bounded Walshness, and vice versa, for various NQS architectures. We provide an algorithm for finding the optimal basis by minimizing the energy of a corresponding classical spin model. This allows us to empirically improve the learnability of various physical quantum states, including ground states of the transverse-field Ising model and mixed-field toric code, often reducing infidelity by orders of magnitude, and generalizes the basis choice given by the well-known Marshall sign rule in frustrated antiferromagnets. Our results provide an intrinsic complexity metric for quantum states with provable connections to their neural-network representability.

full_list.title_en: Physical structure as an organizing principle for universal Hamiltonian learning
full_list.title_zh: 物理结构作为通用哈密顿学习的组织原则
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36135v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Density functional theory (DFT) gives the electronic structure of materials, but its cost limits large-supercell calculations and materials screening. Machine-learned Hamiltonians bypass the self-consistent cycle but are usually system-specific; universal ones could cover new compositions and disordered solids. Such models must generalize across chemistry and keep downstream properties physical, while staying inexpensive for large cells. Here we introduce UniTB, a universal E(3) equivariant Hamiltonian representation framework that integrates physical priors rooted in density-functional tight-binding theory with deep learning. UniTB's network, which corrects a prior Hamiltonian, generalizes across chemistry through a mixture of experts routed by that prior and a charge-equilibration head as in self-consistent-charge tight binding. A projection bounds band shifts from the prior, suppressing spurious states and keeping downstream properties physical. We provide the fastest SO(2) tensor-product GPU kernels for the network. The variant UniTB-Flash assembles its prior from two-center tables at O(N) cost for N atoms, against O(Nlog N) on a grid. Trained on 29,242 crystals, UniTB reaches a 0.48 meV matrix-element error on nonmagnetic test crystals spanning 68 elements. Without amorphous training data, both models agree with DFT optics and conductivity of amorphous Ge-Sb-Te. UniTB-Flash ranks candidates with no significant difference from UniTB, whose property values are more accurate; together they screen 16,195 crystals for five application domains of industrial relevance.

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《物理结构作为通用哈密顿学习的组织原则》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Charge density-supervised real-space representations for atomistic energy prediction
full_list.title_zh: 用于原子能量预测的电荷密度监督实空间表示
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36779v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ground-state electron density contains sufficient information to determine ground-state energy, while providing spatial electronic information. This study developed a charge-density-informed graph neural network (hereafter CDGNN) that jointly learns energy and valence electron density from equivariant atomic graphs. This approach incorporates density-supervised real-space probe representations into the global energy regressor, allowing density-related spatial information to contribute to energy prediction. On the QM9 dataset, CDGNN reduced the energy prediction errors relative to an equivariant GNN baseline for interpolation and extrapolation to larger molecules. For small H-containing Fe and Fe-C datasets, CDGNN performed similarly to the baseline, indicating the dataset-dependent benefits of density supervision. CDGNN also accurately predicted the charge density distributions for molecular and Fe-based systems. The attention analysis showed higher weights for probe representations near the H atoms in Fe-based structures. These findings highlight the potential of integrating charge-density information for energy prediction and its task-dependent benefits.
full_list.abstract_zh: 基态电子密度包含足够的信息来确定基态能量，同时提供空间电子信息。这项研究开发了一种电荷密度信息图神经网络（以下简称 CDGNN），它从等变原子图中联合学习能量和价电子密度。这种方法将密度监督的真实空间探针表示合并到全局能量回归器中，允许与密度相关的空间信息有助于能量预测。在 QM9 数据集上，CDGNN 相对于等变 GNN 基线减少了能量预测误差，用于对较大分子进行插值和外推。

full_list.title_en: Attention as Lattice Gauge Theory: Relations Interact Only Through Wilson Loops
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Attention as Lattice Gauge Theory: Relations Interact Only Through Wilson Loops
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.37656v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Relations compose through the entity they share - Alice is Bob's mother and Bob is Carol's father, so Alice is Carol's grandmother - and the order matters, since a father's mother is not a mother's father; verifying a composed relation means closing the loop. We show that if each entity's coordinate frame may be rotated independently (per-entity frame freedom), three things follow. In the pure-gauge sector, relations that share no cycle cannot interact at all. The only gauge-invariant score of a triangle is a class function of its holonomy H = Tᵢⱼ Tⱼₖ Tₖᵢ - a Wilson loop. And the only equivariant update of an edge is U = Ψ(H), Tᵢⱼ with Ψ conjugation-equivariant. Edge attention by Wilson loops is therefore not one design among many but the unique form the symmetry permits. Three communities hold pieces of this form: the commuting-operator embeddings of knowledge graphs are its abelian (commuting) sector; AlphaFold's triangle update and the Edge Transformer have its shape - an edge updated through the third vertex - without its constraints; and lattice QCD builds it equivariantly on lattices. We instantiate the equivariant sub-family on general relational graphs as holonomy attention. With no training and composition alone, it infers unobserved S₄ relations on sparse graphs at 0.88 with a fifth of the edges corrupted, at or slightly below specialist synchronization algorithms, where every commutative architecture is capped at 0.083; its holonomy score flags corrupted triangles at AUC 0.99 where commuting scores are capped at 0.76 by a second selection rule, and it separates clusters without labels.
full_list.summary: Relations compose through the entity they share - Alice is Bob's mother and Bob is Carol's father, so Alice is Carol's grandmother - and the order matters, since a father's mother is not a mother's fa…
full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：等变神经网络与对称性保持表示。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《Attention as Lattice Gauge Theory: Relations Interact Only Through Wilson Loops》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Back-End-Of-Line Integration of 2-Terminal Ferroelectric Hafnia Synaptic Weights on Commercial CMOS Process
full_list.title_zh: 商用 CMOS 工艺上 2 端子铁电 Hafnia 突触权重的后端集成
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.37530v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Functionalising the back-end-of-line (BEOL) of CMOS with emerging materials is a key route to neural network accelerators and neuromorphic systems. In this work, we demonstrate for the first time the integration of 2-terminal ferroelectric synaptic weights in the BEOL of as-delivered commercial 180 nm CMOS dies. A novel material stack is proposed, in which a WOx/[HfO2-ZrO2] bilayer is sandwiched between TiN and Mo electrodes. For devices annealed at 450 degC, programming below 1.8 V is achieved with a cycle-to-cycle variation below 3 %. Synaptic weights annealed at 500 degC exhibit more gradual weight updates, while the tested underlying NMOS transistors remain functional after the complete integration process. The trade-off between thermal budget and on-device training performance is illustrated using hardware-aware neural network simulations.
full_list.abstract_zh: 用新兴材料功能化CMOS的后端（ BEOL ）是神经网络加速器和神经形态系统的关键途径。在这项工作中，我们首次演示了在交付的商用180纳米CMOS模具的BEOL中集成2端铁电突触重量。提出了一种新型材料堆叠，其中WOx/[HfO2-ZrO2]双层夹在TiN和Mo电极之间。对于在450 ℃退火的器件，以低于3 ％的周期间变化实现低于1.8 V的编程。在500 ℃退火的突触重量表现出更多的渐进重量更新，而经过测试的底层NMOS晶体管在完成集成过程后仍保持功能。

full_list.title_en: Magnetic crystal generation with site-resolved magnetic moments via Gaussian-mixture retargeting and finite-budget yield prediction
full_list.title_zh: 通过高斯混合重定向和有限预算产量预测，利用现场分辨的磁矩生成磁性晶体
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.37222v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce GMMag, a workflow for generating crystal structures together with their site-resolved magnetic moments, built on a conditional variational autoencoder with a graph neural network encoder and a transformer decoder. Gaussian-mixture sampling redirects generation towards selected chemical and magnetic targets without retraining. We systematically investigate how encoder and decoder design, the representation of magnetic-moment magnitudes and relative signs, and sampling choices affect reconstruction, generation quality and diversity. Because a higher screening pass rate does not necessarily yield more qualifying candidates with distinct chemical formulas absent from the reference dataset, we model how repeated generation of the same chemical formulas limits their accumulation and test the model in two separate ten-million-draw runs. As an application, the workflow identifies Nd-containing candidates with chemical formulas absent from the reference dataset, negative formation energies and high estimated saturation magnetization.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们介绍 GMMag，这是一种用于生成晶体结构及其位点解析磁矩的工作流程，构建在带有图神经网络编码器和变压器解码器的条件变分自动编码器上。高斯混合采样将生成重定向到选定的化学和磁性目标，而无需重新训练。我们系统地研究编码器和解码器设计、磁矩幅度和相关符号的表示以及采样选择如何影响重建、生成质量和多样性。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：图神经网络结构—性质建模，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《通过高斯混合重定向和有限预算产量预测，利用现场分辨的磁矩生成磁性晶体》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Magnon Super-Bloch Oscillations and Switchable Transport in Driven Magnonic Crystals
full_list.title_zh: 驱动磁子晶体中的磁子超布洛赫振荡和可切换输运
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36721v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Super-Bloch oscillations (SBOs) offer a powerful route to control wave packet propagation in driven lattices, yet their realization in magnonic systems has remained elusive. Here, we predict SBOs of magnon wave packets in periodic magnonic crystals driven by static and ac gradients of magnetic anisotropy field. A static gradient alone induces magnon Bloch oscillation (BO) with a constant carrier frequency. Remarkably, adding a near-resonant MHz-scale ac driving gives rise to a slow large-amplitude envelope oscillation, the hallmark of SBO. At exact resonance, the ac driving enables phase-controlled directional transport with a carrier-frequency shift up to GHz scale. Consequently, the same structure can be switched among three distinct regimes: conventional BO, SBO, and directed transport. Analytical expressions for the oscillation amplitudes, superperiod, drift velocity, and frequency evolution are validated by micromagnetic simulations. Extending to antiferromagnet magnonic crystals, we further demonstrate that these effects drive opposite motions of two oppositely polarized magnon modes in THz range. Our work establishes magnon SBOs as a versatile platform, opening a new avenue for reconfigurable magnonic devices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 超级布洛赫振荡（SBO）提供了控制驱动晶格中波包传播的强大途径，但它们在磁波系统中的实现仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们预测了由磁各向异性场的静态和交流梯度驱动的周期性磁振子晶体中磁振子波包的 SBO。仅静态梯度就会引起具有恒定载波频率的磁振子布洛赫振荡 (BO)。值得注意的是，添加近谐振 MHz 级交流驱动会产生缓慢的大幅度包络振荡，这是 SBO 的标志。在精确谐振时，交流驱动可实现相控定向传输，载波频率偏移高达 GHz 级。

full_list.title_en: Atom as an Agent: Emergent Order by Collective Predictive Coding
full_list.title_zh: 原子作为代理：集体预测编码的紧急订单
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36673v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: What is the intrinsic reason of emergence of macroscopic order parameter out of microscopic systems? In this article, we apply to physics the collective predictive coding (CPC), the theory of language/symbol emergence. As our language emerges out of our human communications, physical macroscopic order parameter emerges out of communications among atoms --- each atom is regarded as an agent who predicts each other's behavior through inference. We present three examples of classical spin systems: two-dimensional ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic Ising models, a two-dimensional spin model with competing stripe orders, and the fully connected Sherrington--Kirkpatrick spin-glass model. In all of these examples, proper macroscopic order parameters including the replica overlap emerge automatically through communication informatics of CPC, only from observed spin configurations. We call the learned macroscopic coordinate the collective predictive order. Furthermore, for the ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic Ising models, the equilibrium distribution of the collective predictive order yields an emergent potential with the symmetry and thermal evolution characteristic of a Landau potential. Notably, the emergence of the collective predictive order does not refer to any structure of microscopic Hamiltonians/Lagrangians. Thus our ``Atom-as-an-Agent" (AaaA) principle offers a completely data-driven method for the emergence of macroscopic order, that is, machine learning physics.
full_list.abstract_zh: 微观系统中出现宏观序参数的内在原因是什么？在本文中，我们将集体预测编码（CPC），即语言/符号出现理论应用于物理学。正如我们的语言源于人类的交流，物理宏观秩序参数也源于原子之间的交流——每个原子都被视为一个通过推理来预测彼此行为的代理。我们提出了经典自旋系统的三个例子：二维铁磁和反铁磁 Ising 模型、具有竞争条纹顺序的二维自旋模型以及完全连接的 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick 自旋玻璃模型。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 微观系统中出现宏观序参数的内在原因是什么？在本文中，我们将集体预测编码（CPC），即语言/符号出现理论应用于物理学。正如我们的语言源于人类的交流，物理宏观秩序参数也源于原子之间的交流——每个原子都被视为一个通过推理来预测彼此行为的代理。我们提出了经典自旋系统的三个例子：二维铁磁和反铁磁 Ising 模型、具有竞争条纹顺序的二维自旋模型以及完全连接的 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick 自旋玻璃模型。在所有这些例子中，包括副本重叠在内的适当的宏观顺序参数仅通过观察到的自旋配置通过 CPC 的通信信息自动出现。我们将学习到的宏观坐标称为集体预测顺序。此外，对于铁磁和反铁磁伊辛模型，集体预测顺序的平衡分布产生了具有朗道势的对称性和热演化特征的涌现势。值得注意的是，集体预测秩序的出现并不涉及微观哈密顿量/拉格朗日量的任何结构。因此，我们的“原子作为代理”（AaaA）原理为宏观秩序的出现提供了一种完全数据驱动的方法，即机器学习物理学。

full_list.title_en: Cu intercalation and field-driven filament formation in vertically aligned MoS₂ memristors
full_list.title_zh: 垂直排列的 MoS2 忆阻器中的铜嵌入和场驱动细丝形成
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.37152v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vertically-aligned MoS₂ films paired with a Cu top electrode have been used as electrochemical metallization cell memristor devices. The memristive switching has been attributed to the formation of conductive filaments, yet their exact structure has remained elusive. Here we carry out a multi-scale computational study of Cu intercalation, clustering, and field-driven dynamics to eventually model the filament formation under operating conditions. We use density-functional theory results to fine-tune a machine learning force field, and the most important physical phenomena are further distilled into multi-particle kinetic Monte Carlo simulations. By exhaustive enumeration of Cu intercalated structures, we find the most stable structure at MoS₂Cu₀.₁₁ composition, with Cu atoms forming a dice lattice between the MoS₂ layers. These structures are shown to exhibit metallic character and can thus form conductive filaments under memristor operation. The simulated switching speed and threshold voltage agree well with the available experimental data. Our results give fundamental insights on the device operation mechanism and guidelines for maximizing switching speed and endurance.
full_list.abstract_zh: 垂直排列的 MoS2 薄膜与 Cu 顶部电极配对，已被用作电化学金属化电池忆阻器器件。忆阻开关被归因于导电丝的形成，但它们的确切结构仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们对铜嵌入、聚类和场驱动动力学进行了多尺度计算研究，以最终模拟操作条件下的细丝形成。我们使用密度泛函理论结果来微调机器学习力场，并且最重要的物理现象被进一步提炼为多粒子动力学蒙特卡罗模拟。通过对 Cu 插层结构的详尽列举，我们发现 MoS2Cu0.11 成分中最稳定的结构，其中 Cu 原子在 MoS2 层之间形成骰子晶格。

full_list.title_en: Learning the Chronology of Materials Discovery for Synthesizability Prediction
full_list.title_zh: 了解材料发现的年表以预测可合成性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36193v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-throughput computational and generative approaches are proposing candidate materials far faster than they can be synthesized, making it increasingly important to identify which hypothetical materials are likely to be experimentally realizable. Positive-unlabeled (PU) learning has emerged as a representative framework for synthesizability prediction, yet existing approaches treat experimentally reported materials as a static collection, overlooking the historical trajectory of materials discovery and the diverse practical factors that have driven its progress. Here we introduce ChronoSyn, a chronology-aware machine learning model that jointly learns synthesizability and the relative reporting order of known materials through a shared composition representation. Incorporating discovery chronology provides additional supervision beyond conventional synthesizability labels, improving prediction performance and enabling ChronoSyn to identify experimentally realizable compositions more effectively than baseline models. Applied to approximately 50 million hypothetical compositions, ChronoSyn identifies chemically coherent high-scoring families that include experimentally reported compositions unseen during training. These results highlight the chronology of materials discovery as an informative learning signal and suggest that the path along which known materials were discovered can point the way to those that will be discovered in the future.
full_list.abstract_zh: 高通量计算和生成方法提出候选材料的速度远远快于合成速度，这使得确定哪些假设材料可能通过实验实现变得越来越重要。正向无标记（PU）学习已成为可合成性预测的代表性框架，但现有方法将实验报告的材料视为静态集合，忽视了材料发现的历史轨迹以及推动其进步的各种实际因素。在这里，我们介绍 ChronoSyn，这是一种时间感知机器学习模型，它通过共享的成分表示来共同学习已知材料的可合成性和相对报告顺序。

full_list.title_en: Protonic thermoelectric effect of Superionic H₂O and magnetic field generation in Uranus and Neptune
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Protonic thermoelectric effect of Superionic H₂O and magnetic field generation in Uranus and Neptune
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2601.03659v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The origin of the anomalous magnetic fields of Uranus and Neptune, with significant tilts and multi-dipole configurations, is central to understanding the internal structure and evolution of the ice giants. Recent investigations confirmed that superionic H₂O ice is thermodynamically stable and constitutes the dominant H₂O phase within their icy mantles. Here, we use deep learning and ab initio molecular dynamics to investigate the thermal and protonic transport properties of superionic H₂O ice. We demonstrate that superionic H₂O ice exhibits a pronounced protonic thermoelectric effect, with a maximum Seebeck coefficient that can reach sim 620 μV K⁻¹ within the interior of Uranus, whereas Neptune's is lower, within the range of 570-585 μV K⁻¹. Consequently, the temperature gradients in the icy mantles can induce proton migration, thereby driving magnetic field generation. Based on this mechanism, and within a dipolar approximation that captures the mean field, the disparities in mean dipolar magnetic field strength between Uranus and Neptune can be explained exclusively by their differing internal temperature gradients, and the predicted mean field strengths are comparable to those observed by Voyager 2.

full_list.title_en: Continuum neural wavefunctions for anyons on a torus
full_list.title_zh: 环面上任意子的连续神经波函数
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36567v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mobile anyons in topologically ordered phases provide a setting to investigate how fractional exchange statistics shapes collective behavior at finite density. We introduce AnyFormer: a neural variational framework for continuum anyons on a torus that explicitly incorporates statistical interactions and global winding constraints. We construct a smooth orbital frame that enforces the matrix-valued torus boundary conditions, and supplement it with an analytic pair factor that supplies the regular collision behavior. The orbital geometry and many-body amplitudes are optimized in parallel by variational Monte Carlo. We apply AnyFormer to semions without an external field or interaction potential, isolating unique correlations generated solely by statistics. Our framework closely matches exact two-semion energies and yields lower variational energies than finite-cutoff exact diagonalization for N = 4 and 6 semions. Scaling up to N = 16 semions, well beyond the limits of continuum diagonalization, our calculations reveal states with pronounced correlation holes, suppressed long-wavelength density fluctuations, and a reversal of pair circulation at a distance set by the mean particle spacing. For N = 12 and 16 semions, the circulation develops damped spatial oscillations. AnyFormer thus provides a scalable variational neural-net framework for microscopic studies of correlations, chiral motion, and collective phases of bulk anyonic matter.
full_list.abstract_zh: 拓扑有序相中的移动任意子提供了一个研究分数交换统计如何在有限密度下塑造集体行为的环境。我们介绍 AnyFormer：环面上连续任意子的神经变分框架，它明确地结合了统计相互作用和全局缠绕约束。我们构建了一个平滑的轨道框架，强制执行矩阵值环面边界条件，并用提供常规碰撞行为的解析对因子对其进行补充。通过变分蒙特卡罗并行优化轨道几何结构和多体振幅。我们将 AnyFormer 应用于没有外部场或相互作用势的半子，隔离仅由统计生成的独特相关性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 拓扑有序相中的移动任意子提供了一个研究分数交换统计如何在有限密度下塑造集体行为的环境。我们介绍 AnyFormer：环面上连续任意子的神经变分框架，它明确地结合了统计相互作用和全局缠绕约束。我们构建了一个平滑的轨道框架，强制执行矩阵值环面边界条件，并用提供常规碰撞行为的解析对因子对其进行补充。通过变分蒙特卡罗并行优化轨道几何结构和多体振幅。我们将 AnyFormer 应用于没有外部场或相互作用势的半子，隔离仅由统计生成的独特相关性。我们的框架与 N = 4 和 6 个半子能量紧密匹配，并且比有限截止精确对角化产生更低的变分能量。扩展到 N = 16 个半子，远远超出连续对角化的限制，我们的计算揭示了具有明显相关空洞的状态，抑制了长波长密度波动，以及在平均粒子间距设定的距离处对循环的逆转。对于 N = 12 和 16 个半子，环流会产生阻尼空间振荡。因此，AnyFormer 提供了一个可扩展的变分神经网络框架，用于微观研究大块任意子物质的相关性、手性运动和集体相。
full_list.summary: 拓扑有序相中的移动任意子提供了一个研究分数交换统计如何在有限密度下塑造集体行为的环境。我们介绍 AnyFormer：环面上连续任意子的神经变分框架，它明确地结合了统计相互作用和全局缠绕约束。我们构建了一个平滑的轨道框架，强制执行矩阵值环面边界条件，并用提供常规碰撞行为的解析对因子对其进行补充。通过变分蒙特卡罗并行优化轨道几何结构和多体振幅。我们将 AnyFormer 应用于没有外部场或相互作用势的半子，隔离仅由统计生成的独特相关性。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：蒙特卡洛统计采样。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《环面上任意子的连续神经波函数》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Ground-State Properties of a Lattice-Coupled Strongly Correlated Model for Solid Oxygen under Pressure
full_list.title_zh: 压力下固体氧晶格耦合强相关模型的基态特性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36697v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Solid oxygen is an S=1 molecular magnet with strong coupling between spin and lattice degrees of freedom. Recent studies suggest that magnetic moments coexist with tetramer distortions under pressure. We derive an effective spin Hamiltonian from a two-orbital Peierls--Hubbard model with spin-orbit coupling. The resulting model contains competing easy-plane single-ion and easy-axis exchange anisotropies. We analyze this model on a square lattice using quantum Monte Carlo simulations and evaluate the magnetic contribution to the lattice stiffness for several lattice distortion patterns including the tetramer pattern. We find that the tetramer pattern is the most favorable among the considered distortion patterns throughout the parameter range studied. Moreover, competition between the two anisotropies enhances the tendency toward lattice distortion and strengthens the preference for tetramerization over the other patterns.
full_list.abstract_zh: 固体氧是一种S=1分子磁体，自旋自由度和晶格自由度之间具有强耦合。最近的研究表明，磁矩在压力下与四聚体扭曲共存。我们从具有自旋轨道耦合的双轨道 Peierls--Hubbard 模型导出了有效的自旋哈密顿量。所得模型包含相互竞争的易平面单离子和易轴交换各向异性。我们使用量子蒙特卡罗模拟在方形晶格上分析该模型，并评估包括四聚体模式在内的几种晶格畸变模式的磁力对晶格刚度的贡献。我们发现，在整个研究的参数范围内，四聚体模式是所考虑的畸变模式中最有利的。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 固体氧是一种S=1分子磁体，自旋自由度和晶格自由度之间具有强耦合。最近的研究表明，磁矩在压力下与四聚体扭曲共存。我们从具有自旋轨道耦合的双轨道 Peierls--Hubbard 模型导出了有效的自旋哈密顿量。所得模型包含相互竞争的易平面单离子和易轴交换各向异性。我们使用量子蒙特卡罗模拟在方形晶格上分析该模型，并评估包括四聚体模式在内的几种晶格畸变模式的磁力对晶格刚度的贡献。我们发现，在整个研究的参数范围内，四聚体模式是所考虑的畸变模式中最有利的。此外，两种各向异性之间的竞争增强了晶格畸变的趋势，并增强了四聚化相对于其他模式的偏好。
full_list.summary: 固体氧是一种S=1分子磁体，自旋自由度和晶格自由度之间具有强耦合。最近的研究表明，磁矩在压力下与四聚体扭曲共存。我们从具有自旋轨道耦合的双轨道 Peierls--Hubbard 模型导出了有效的自旋哈密顿量。所得模型包含相互竞争的易平面单离子和易轴交换各向异性。我们使用量子蒙特卡罗模拟在方形晶格上分析该模型，并评估包括四聚体模式在内的几种晶格畸变模式的磁力对晶格刚度的贡献。我们发现，在整个研究的参数范围内，四聚体模式是所考虑的畸变模式中最有利的。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量, 蒙特卡洛统计采样，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: Large superconducting diode effect indicates nonuniform triplet pairing in UTe2
full_list.title_zh: 大超导二极管效应表明 UTe2 中的三重态配对不均匀
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36332v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The superconducting diode effect (SDE) is characterized by unequal critical current magnitudes for opposite-polarity current flow, owing to broken spatial-inversion and time-reversal symmetries. For a superconducting pair wavefunction to spontaneously break inversion symmetry implies the formation of Cooper pairs with nonzero momentum, yielding a nonuniform superconducting state. For singlet superconductors, the formation of such a (FFLO) state has long been understood to provide an escape from high field Pauli pair-breaking -- how and why such an effect might occur for equal spin pairing is an open question. Here we report the observation of a large SDE in bulk specimens of the three-dimensional heavy-fermion triplet superconductor UTe₂, with a peak diode efficiency of 33% at the high magnetic field strength of 33.6 T, representing the highest-field observation of the SDE to date. Crucially, this nonreciprocal transport is strictly confined to a narrow field regime where superconductivity coexists with a field-induced spin-polarized state near a first-order metamagnetic phase boundary. The absence of the SDE away from this slender phase-intersection argues strongly against purely extrinsic vortex pinning asymmetries. Instead, our findings indicate spontaneous inversion symmetry breaking accompanied by finite-momentum Cooper pairing. We model this behavior using a phenomenological Ginzburg-Landau theory, demonstrating that the intertwining of magnetic and triplet superconducting orders can stabilize an odd-parity FFLO state.
full_list.abstract_zh: 超导二极管效应 (SDE) 的特点是，由于空间反转和时间反转对称性被破坏，相反极性电流的临界电流大小不相等。对于超导对波函数来说，自发打破反演对称性意味着形成具有非零动量的库珀对，从而产生非均匀超导态。对于单线态超导体，这种（FFLO）态的形成长期以来一直被认为可以避免高场泡利对断裂——对于相等的自旋配对如何以及为什么会发生这种效应是一个悬而未决的问题。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 超导二极管效应 (SDE) 的特点是，由于空间反转和时间反转对称性被破坏，相反极性电流的临界电流大小不相等。对于超导对波函数来说，自发打破反演对称性意味着形成具有非零动量的库珀对，从而产生非均匀超导态。对于单线态超导体，这种（FFLO）态的形成长期以来一直被认为可以避免高场泡利对断裂——对于相等的自旋配对如何以及为什么会发生这种效应是一个悬而未决的问题。在这里，我们报告了在三维重费米子三重态超导体 UTe2 的块状样品中观察到的大型 SDE，在 33.6 T 的高磁场强度下峰值二极管效率为 33%，代表了迄今为止 SDE 的最高场观测。至关重要的是，这种不可逆输运严格限制在狭窄的场范围内，其中超导性与一阶变磁相边界附近的场诱导自旋极化态共存。远离这个细长相交处不存在 SDE 强烈反对纯粹的外在涡旋钉扎不对称性。相反，我们的研究结果表明自发反演对称性破缺伴随着有限动量库珀配对。我们使用唯象金兹堡-朗道理论对这种行为进行建模，证明磁性和三重态超导序的交织可以稳定奇宇称 FFLO 状态。

full_list.title_en: Spin-Charge Conversion in an Epitaxial Kagome Flat-Band Metal
full_list.title_zh: 外延 Kagome 平带金属中的自旋电荷转换
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36501v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The formation of topological flat bands near the Fermi level in kagome-structured metals has generated substantial research interest. One key consequence of this electronic structure is the strong anisotropy in charge transport, such as the significantly higher in-plane resistivity relative to the out-of-plane direction. However, the spin transport properties of these flat-band kagome metals are still largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate spin-charge conversion in CoSn, a representative flat-band kagome metal. Scanning tunneling microscopy is employed to image the CoSn surface with atomic resolution, and dI/dV spectroscopy shows clear signatures of the flat bands. Using magneto-optical techniques, we quantify the spin-orbit torque (SOT) in bilayers of ferromagnetic nickel (Ni) and c-plane CoSn thin films. We find a large effective spin Hall angle of θSH = 0.484 ± 0.005 within the CoSn layers, significantly exceeding the value measured for Pt of θSH = 0.0436 ± 0.0003 in Ni/Pt bilayers. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations provide a microscopic understanding of the intrinsic spin Hall effect in CoSn, elucidating the sources of Berry curvature in momentum space. These findings establish kagome metals as promising materials for efficient spin-charge conversion and low-power spintronics.
full_list.abstract_zh: kagome 结构金属中费米能级附近拓扑平带的形成引起了人们的广泛研究兴趣。这种电子结构的一个关键后果是电荷传输中的强各向异性，例如相对于面外方向明显更高的面内电阻率。然而，这些平带戈薇金属的自旋输运特性在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这项工作中，我们研究了 CoSn（一种代表性的平带戈薇金属）中的自旋电荷转换。采用扫描隧道显微镜对 CoSn 表面进行原子分辨率成像，dI/dV 光谱显示出清晰的平带特征。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: kagome 结构金属中费米能级附近拓扑平带的形成引起了人们的广泛研究兴趣。这种电子结构的一个关键后果是电荷传输中的强各向异性，例如相对于面外方向明显更高的面内电阻率。然而，这些平带戈薇金属的自旋输运特性在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这项工作中，我们研究了 CoSn（一种代表性的平带戈薇金属）中的自旋电荷转换。采用扫描隧道显微镜对 CoSn 表面进行原子分辨率成像，dI/dV 光谱显示出清晰的平带特征。使用磁光技术，我们量化了铁磁镍 (Ni) 和 c 面 CoSn 薄膜双层中的自旋轨道扭矩 (SOT)。我们发现 CoSn 层内的有效自旋霍尔角较大，为 θSH = 0.484 ± 0.005，明显超过 Ni/Pt 双层中 Pt 的测量值 θSH = 0.0436 ± 0.0003。密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算提供了对 CoSn 中固有自旋霍尔效应的微观理解，阐明了动量空间中贝里曲率的来源。这些发现确立了戈薇金属作为高效自旋电荷转换和低功耗自旋电子学的有前途的材料。

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《外延 Kagome 平带金属中的自旋电荷转换》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: The role of A in ARPES
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：The role of A in ARPES
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36909v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) was developed in the 1970s-1990s as a momentum-resolved probe of the electronic structure of solids, with its basic principles summarized in early seminal works and classic reviews. The basic ARPES result is currently almost exclusively associated with the two-dimensional intensity distribution with coordinate axes labeled as Binding Energy and Momentum. Such datasets are usually directly compared to the band structure calculations along high symmetry directions of the Brillouin zone. Here we show that this is the result of an oversimplified treatment of the ARPES data leading to incorrect interpretations of the experimental results. We suggest practical ways of how to avoid it in both data collection and analysis.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: Topological Criticality with Charge-(3e) Fluctuations in the (SU(3)) Triangular-Lattice Hofstadter--Hubbard Model
full_list.title_zh: (SU (3))三角格Hofstadter-Hubbard模型中带电荷的拓扑临界性- (3e)波动
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.37575v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A transition between an integer quantum Hall insulator and a chiral spin liquid can become critical without closing the single-electron gap, raising the question of which composite excitations govern the change in topological order. We investigate this question in the (SU(3)) triangular-lattice Hofstadter--Hubbard model at one particle per site and magnetic flux (π/3) per triangle. Using infinite density matrix renormalization group calculations, we identify a weak-coupling integer quantum Hall phase and an interaction-driven (SU(3)₁) chiral spin liquid. Near the transition, both the neutral and charge-(3e) correlation lengths increase substantially, whereas the single-electron correlation length remains short, providing evidence for a Chern--Simons--Higgs critical theory, where a gauge-invariant monopole carries the quantum numbers of a fermionic (SU(3))-singlet trion. We discuss the implications for doping the system and recent experiments on doping (ν=-2/3) fractional quantum anomalous Hall in tMoTe(₂).
full_list.abstract_zh: 整数量子霍尔绝缘体和手性自旋液体之间的过渡可以在不关闭单电子间隙的情况下变得至关重要，这引发了哪种复合激发控制拓扑顺序变化的问题。我们在（ SU （ 3 ） ）三角晶格Hofstadter-Hubbard模型中研究这个问题，每个位置一个粒子，每个三角形的磁通量（ π/3 ）。使用无限密度矩阵重整群计算，我们确定了一个弱耦合整数量子霍尔相和一个相互作用驱动的（ SU （ 3 ） ）手性自旋液体。

full_list.title_en: Where Does the Anion-Redox Hole Go? Reliability of Open-Shell Projection-Based Embedding for Li-Rich Cathodes, from DFT Environments to Quantum Solvers
full_list.title_zh: 阴离子氧化还原空穴去了哪里？从 DFT 环境到量子求解器，富锂阴极开壳投影嵌入的可靠性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36659v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Anion redox in Li-rich layered oxides places holes on oxygen next to an antiferromagnetic Mn(IV) d3 lattice, a strongly correlated open-shell problem for which projection-based wavefunction-in-DFT embedding offers a route to correlated and quantum solvers, but whose errors are known mainly for closed-shell molecules. We develop a spin-unrestricted projection-based embedding, exact at the DFT-in-DFT level to the microhartree scale for closed-shell, broken-symmetry and high-spin references with point charges, and apply DMRG-in-DFT to point-charge clusters of delithiated Li(2-x)MnO3, varying the environment functional (0-100% exact exchange), geometry, active region, active-space spin, virtual space, cluster size and magnetic reference. In every setting the lowest SCF state places the hole on an oxygen pair, with no O-O bond. How the hole is shared depends on the functional together with the geometry: hybrids give a full, uncoupled hole at the DFT+U geometry but a partial, weakly covalent hole at their own geometry, a change of up to 0.5 e on one oxygen. Where spin spreads across the active/environment boundary, the integer spin projection of the active space becomes a choice worth up to 0.26 e, and at most 0.09 e once the two Mn neighbors are included. An extended state search found missed lower states for two functionals, changing a pair-oxygen spin by up to 0.45 e. Across all 82 runs the embedded mean field gives the same hole (median DMRG change 0.02-0.04 e); correlation mainly adds O-O covalency. State control and geometry consistency, not the solver, dominate the uncertainty, and total energies are not converged at 30-40 orbitals. For quantum solvers, the embedded Hamiltonian must be spin-unrestricted: a shared-orbital form reverses the hole, while sample-based quantum diagonalization reproduces exact diagonalization, as accurately as, but not better than, classical selected CI.
full_list.abstract_zh: 富锂层状氧化物中的阴离子氧化还原在反铁磁 Mn(IV) d3 晶格旁边的氧上放置空穴，这是一个强相关的开壳问题，基于投影的 DFT 波函数嵌入为相关和量子求解器提供了一条途径，但其误差主要针对闭壳分子。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 富锂层状氧化物中的阴离子氧化还原在反铁磁 Mn(IV) d3 晶格旁边的氧上放置空穴，这是一个强相关的开壳问题，基于投影的 DFT 波函数嵌入为相关和量子求解器提供了一条途径，但其误差主要针对闭壳分子。我们开发了一种基于自旋不受限制的投影的嵌入，在 DFT-in-DFT 水平上精确到 microhartree 尺度，用于闭壳、破缺对称性和点电荷的高自旋参考，并将 DMRG-in-DFT 应用于脱锂 Li(2-x)MnO3 的点电荷簇，改变环境功能（0-100% 精确交换）、几何形状、活性区域、活性空间自旋、虚拟空间、簇大小和磁参考。在每种设置中，最低的 SCF 状态都将空穴置于氧对上，没有 O-O 键。空穴的共享方式取决于函数和几何结构：杂化体在 DFT+U 几何结构中提供完整的、未耦合的空穴，但在其自身几何结构中提供部分弱共价空穴，一个氧上的变化最多为 0.5 e。当自旋分布在活动/环境边界上时，活动空间的整数自旋投影成为一个值高达 0.26 e 的选择，一旦包含两个 Mn 邻居，则最多为 0.09 e。扩展状态搜索发现两个泛函遗漏了较低的状态，将氧对自旋改变了高达 0.45 e。在所有 82 次运行中，嵌入的平均场给出了相同的空洞（中值 DMRG 变化 0.02-0.04 e）；相关性主要是增加O-O共价性。状态控制和几何一致性，而不是求解器，决定了不确定性，并且总能量不收敛于 30-40 轨道。对于量子求解器，嵌入的哈密顿量必须是自旋不受限制的：共享轨道形式反转空穴，而基于样本的量子对角化再现精确的对角化，与经典选择的 CI 一样准确，但不比它更好。

full_list.title_en: Symmetry-resolved superconducting diode response
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Symmetry-resolved superconducting diode response
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2605.04928v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The superconducting diode effect manifests as nonreciprocal properties of critical currents, yet a systematic tensorial framework for its symmetry-governed responses remains lacking. We develop such a framework by relating the angular harmonics of critical currents to the magnetic field. Crystalline symmetries constrain the dipolar response to be purely antisymmetric (Hall-like) in Rashba superconductors with C₃ᵥ, C₄ᵥ, or C₆ᵥ symmetry, whereas they require a diagonal, traceless tensor in Dresselhaus superconductors with D₂d symmetry. For systems with fourfold symmetry, the octupole response appears at linear order, whose response tensors take symmetric off-diagonal and identity forms for C₄ᵥ and D₂d symmetries, respectively. Furthermore, nematicity activates otherwise forbidden tensor components, providing a sensitive probe of rotational symmetry breaking in superconductors. At cubic order in the magnetic field, the nonlinear response tensors likewise exhibit distinct symmetry-dependent patterns. Our framework establishes a symmetry-resolved characterization of the superconducting diode effect and provides a route to probing the underlying electronic structure and symmetry-breaking orders.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Symmetry-resolved superconducting diode response》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Electric Field-Induced Hole- and Electron-Type Flat Bands in Twisted Double Bilayer Graphene
full_list.title_zh: 扭曲双双层石墨烯中的电场感应空穴和电子型平带
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.37402v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Application of a finite electric field and small twist angle between two graphene bilayers leads to widely tunable electronic structures that support emergent phenomena. Here, we measure the electronic structure of twisted double bilayer graphene with twist angles of 3.1cⁱrc and 6.0cⁱrc using micro-focused angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (microARPES) on in situ gated samples. At a twist angle of 6.0cⁱrc, we find that the dispersion around the valence and conduction band extrema is unchanged compared to separate graphene bilayers, whereas electric field tunable hybridisation gaps and band flattening effects occur at higher binding energies. In the 3.1cⁱrc structure, we find that the resulting superlattice drives dispersion changes around the valence and conduction band edges. Increasing the gate-induced doping in the bottom bilayer leads to the formation of flat bands between the valence band maximum in the bottom bilayer and conduction band minimum in the top bilayer. Our experiments establish combinations of twist angle and electric field that potentially support strong electron-hole excitations and that provide a benchmark for the theoretical description of moderately twisted double bilayer graphene.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在两个石墨烯双层之间应用有限电场和小扭转角可产生支持涌现现象的广泛可调电子结构。在这里，我们使用微聚焦角分辨光电子能谱 (microARPES) 在原位门控样品上测量了扭转角为 3.1cⁱrc 和 6.0cⁱrc 的扭转双双层石墨烯的电子结构。在扭转角为 6.0cⁱrc 时，我们发现与单独的石墨烯双层相比，价带和导带极值周围的色散没有变化，而电场可调的杂化间隙和能带平坦效应发生在较高的结合能下。

full_list.title_en: A Hierarchy of Exact Lower Bounds on the Laughlin Spectral Gap
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：A Hierarchy of Exact Lower Bounds on the Laughlin Spectral Gap
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.18854v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We develop a bootstrap approach to deriving lower bounds on the spectral gap of the first Haldane pseudopotential Hamiltonian on the sphere with N_Φ flux quanta for arbitrary N_Φ, including in the thermodynamic limit N_Φ → infty. This method can in principle be generalized to pseudopotentials describing other model wavefunctions such as the Moore--Read state or Read--Rezayi sequence. Our approach is based on Knabe's observation that if H is a Hamiltonian with ground state energy zero then the spectral gap is at least ϵ > 0 if and only if H² succeq ϵ H. To show this inequality, we split H² into two parts, one that can be analytically bounded and another that can be bounded using a finite semidefinite program (SDP). Crucially, the size of this program is determined only by cutoff parameters, and the program depends on N_Φ only parametrically, allowing us to obtain numerically exact (up to solver precision) lower bounds on the gap. In order to turn these numerical bounds into mathematically rigorous results, we introduce an algorithm that can produce nearly-optimal exact interior feasible points for large rational SDPs even if the affine constraints are highly redundant and ill-conditioned. We additionally provide an algorithm that establishes the rank stability of the SDP in the N_Φ → infty limit, which is needed to certify the bound in the thermodynamic limit. Beyond establishing a Laughlin gap greater than 1/100 in the thermodynamic limit and revealing a potential method for deriving spectral gap lower bounds for other pseudopotentials, our work provides a general method for turning numerical SDP bounds into rigorous mathematical proofs, which may have wide applicability. In particular, this work demonstrates that bootstrap methods can be used to rigorously resolve major open problems in quantum many-body physics.

full_list.title_en: Curvature-stabilized three-dimensional spiral states and local-field nucleation of skyrmions on spherical caps
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Curvature-stabilized three-dimensional spiral states and local-field nucleation of skyrmions on spherical caps
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2511.22557v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetic skyrmions stabilized by interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions (DMI) are promising candidates for applications in memory, logic, and neuromorphic computing. Beyond planar films, theoretical studies predict that curvature can influence skyrmion stability by introducing effective chiral interactions. Here, we investigate skyrmion formation on self-assembled polystyrene particles coated with Pt/Co/Ta multilayers by magnetron sputtering. Vibrating sample magnetometry reveals clear differences in the magnetic reversal behavior of the curvilinear film compared to that of the planar counterpart. Using non-invasive imaging methods such as scanning transmission X-ray microscopy and high-sensitivity in-vacuum magnetic force microscopy (MFM) with low moment magnetic tipcs, we observe a maze domain pattern for the planar films while the curvilinear film reveals three-dimensional spiraling stripe states. By employing a conventional MFM operating under ambient conditions requiring a tip with a higher magnetic moment, we demonstrate that these stripe states can rupture into metastable skyrmions located at the top of the spherical particles by applying consecutive scans. Our results demonstrate that curvilinear films offer an accessible platform for stabilizing single skyrmions using local magnetic field stimuli, opening pathways to study the interplay between interfacial and curvature-induced DMIs and enabling controlled skyrmion writing on three-dimensional magnetic architectures.

full_list.title_en: Ferron-driven motion of non-collinear ferroelectric domain walls
full_list.title_zh: 非共线铁电畴壁的铁驱动运动
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36614v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the propagation of ferrons, the quanta of electric polarization waves, through a ferroelectric texture. We predict by analytic and numerical calculations that a 90^circ domain wall (DW) operates as a beam splitter of longitudinal ferron and transverse optical phonon modes. An associated momentum-flux imbalance leads to forces that drive DW motion. In the weak-anisotropy limit, the DW becomes a rotating texture with nearly fixed-modulus, whose low-energy dynamics is described by a sine-Gordon equation. A ferron source then attracts the DW through a damping-induced force. Both driving forces scale linearly with incident wave intensity. Our results uncover qualitatively different routes to driven ferroelectric DW motion enabled by the vector nature of the polarization and offer functionalities for THz ferroelectric devices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们通过铁电结构研究铁离子（电极化波的量子）的传播。我们通过分析和数值计算预测，90^circ 畴壁 (DW) 可用作纵向铁子和横向光学声子模式的分束器。相关的动量通量不平衡会导致驱动 DW 运动的力。在弱各向异性极限下，DW 变成模量几乎固定的旋转纹理，其低能动力学由正弦戈登方程描述。然后，铁离子源通过阻尼感应力吸引 DW。两种驱动力都与入射波强度成线性比例。我们的结果揭示了由极化矢量性质驱动的铁电 DW 运动的不同性质的途径，并为太赫兹铁电器件提供了功能。

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: First-principles-based search for emergent topological spin textures in transition-metal dichalcogenide monolayers
full_list.title_zh: 基于第一原理的过渡金属二硫族化物单层中的新兴拓扑自旋纹理的搜索
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36542v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological spin textures such as skyrmions and bimerons offer rich physical functionalities and strong potential for future spin-based technologies. Identifying materials that host such emergent magnetic states, however, remains challenging due to the complex interplay between microscopic magnetic interactions and large-scale spin textures. Here, using a multiscale first-principles discovery framework, we identify a broad class of two-dimensional materials that stabilize nontrivial spin textures. The framework integrates relativistic density functional theory, magnetic force theory, and atomistic spin-dynamics simulations, enabling a direct connection between electronic interactions and emergent magnetic textures and allowing efficient screening of systems with large magnetic unit cells and competing exchange interactions. Applying this approach, we systematically screen 312 monolayer transition-metal dichalcogenides across 1T and 2H phases of 3d, 4d, and 5d transition metals. We uncover a diverse set of emergent spin textures, including skyrmions, bimerons, and complex domain states, and clarify their distinct stabilization mechanisms driven by exchange interactions, Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions, and magnetic frustration. These results identify promising candidate materials for topological spin textures and establish a transferable computational framework for accelerating materials discovery of complex magnetic states in two dimensions.
full_list.abstract_zh: 斯格明子和双聚体等拓扑自旋纹理为未来基于自旋的技术提供了丰富的物理功能和强大的潜力。然而，由于微观磁相互作用和大规模自旋纹理之间复杂的相互作用，识别具有这种新兴磁态的材料仍然具有挑战性。在这里，使用多尺度第一原理发现框架，我们确定了一大类稳定非平凡自旋纹理的二维材料。该框架集成了相对论密度泛函理论、磁力理论和原子自旋动力学模拟，实现了电子相互作用和新兴磁性纹理之间的直接联系，并允许有效筛选具有大型磁性单元和竞争交换相互作用的系统。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 斯格明子和双聚体等拓扑自旋纹理为未来基于自旋的技术提供了丰富的物理功能和强大的潜力。然而，由于微观磁相互作用和大规模自旋纹理之间复杂的相互作用，识别具有这种新兴磁态的材料仍然具有挑战性。在这里，使用多尺度第一原理发现框架，我们确定了一大类稳定非平凡自旋纹理的二维材料。该框架集成了相对论密度泛函理论、磁力理论和原子自旋动力学模拟，实现了电子相互作用和新兴磁性纹理之间的直接联系，并允许有效筛选具有大型磁性单元和竞争交换相互作用的系统。应用这种方法，我们系统地筛选了 3d、4d 和 5d 过渡金属的 1T 和 2H 相的 312 个单层过渡金属二硫属化物。我们发现了一系列不同的新兴自旋结构，包括斯格明子、双聚子和复杂的域态，并阐明了它们由交换相互作用、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用和磁挫败驱动的独特稳定机制。这些结果确定了拓扑自旋纹理的有前途的候选材料，并建立了可转移的计算框架，以加速二维复杂磁态的材料发现。

full_list.title_en: In-situ Control of the Photon-Magnon Synchronized Mode in a Miniaturized Magnetometer
full_list.title_zh: 小型磁力计中光子-磁振子同步模式的原位控制
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36705v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photon-magnon synchronized modes (PMSMs) provide a route for magnetic-field sensing by exploiting their enhanced field responsivity due to cusp points (CPs). However, the previous PMSM magnetometer relies on bulky discrete components and lacks in situ control of photon-magnon interactions, limiting its integration and adaptability. Here, we demonstrate a miniaturized PMSM magnetometer integrated on a printed circuit board. A variable resistor is used to tune the photon-magnon coupling strength in situ. By adjusting the variable resistor, the electromagnetic boundary condition of the magnetometer is altered; hence, the reservoir-mediated photon-magnon interaction is changed. The coupling strength shows a non-monotonic dependence on the reflection coefficient adjusted by the variable resistor and reaches its minimum at the impedance matching condition. Furthermore, we develop a non-Hermitian model with standing-wave interference to describe the PMSM dispersion and derive the critical condition for CP formation. This work realizes a compact and tunable PMSM magnetometer and provides a pathway for controlling photon-magnon interactions in integrated magnetic sensing systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 光子磁振子同步模式 (PMSM) 通过利用尖点 (CP) 增强的场响应度，为磁场传感提供了一条途径。然而，之前的 PMSM 磁力计依赖于笨重的分立元件，缺乏对光子-磁振子相互作用的原位控制，限制了其集成度和适应性。在这里，我们演示了集成在印刷电路板上的微型 PMSM 磁力计。可变电阻器用于原位调节光子-磁振子耦合强度。通过调节可变电阻，改变磁力计的电磁边界条件；因此，储层介导的光子-磁振子相互作用发生了变化。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 光子磁振子同步模式 (PMSM) 通过利用尖点 (CP) 增强的场响应度，为磁场传感提供了一条途径。然而，之前的 PMSM 磁力计依赖于笨重的分立元件，缺乏对光子-磁振子相互作用的原位控制，限制了其集成度和适应性。在这里，我们演示了集成在印刷电路板上的微型 PMSM 磁力计。可变电阻器用于原位调节光子-磁振子耦合强度。通过调节可变电阻，改变磁力计的电磁边界条件；因此，储层介导的光子-磁振子相互作用发生了变化。耦合强度对可变电阻调节的反射系数呈现非单调依赖性，并在阻抗匹配条件下达到最小值。此外，我们开发了一种具有驻波干扰的非厄米特模型来描述 PMSM 色散并推导出 CP 形成的临界条件。这项工作实现了紧凑且可调谐的 PMSM 磁力计，并为控制集成磁传感系统中的光子-磁振子相互作用提供了途径。

full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在具有恒定玻色子浓度的运动学解释的经典蒙特卡罗方法的框架内，研究了镍酸盐模型，并确定了考虑到第三近邻的不同交换积分值的磁结构。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：蒙特卡洛统计采样，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《镍酸盐模型中的磁性结构：蒙特卡罗研究》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Spin Rectification in Series and Parallel Networks of Ferromagnets
full_list.title_zh: 铁磁体串联和并联网络中的自旋整流
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36213v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the experimental study of spin rectification in parallel and series networks of ferromagnetic conductors. The networks were composed of Ni36Fe64 elements (wires) which, when subject to ferromagnetic resonance (FMR), develop a small spin-rectification photovoltage. We found that the effect of spin rectification can be modeled as an increase in resistance of the ferromagnetic elements and closely follows the usual dependence of total network resistance in series and parallel electric circuits: the total spin-rectification photovoltage in ferromagnetic wires connected in series is equal to the algebraic sum of contributions from individual wires, while in the parallel connection one needs to add the reciprocals of the individual contributions. Our results support a simple way to control and manipulate the magnitude of spin-rectification photovoltage in multi-element spintronic devices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们提出了铁磁导体并联和串联网络中自旋整流的实验研究。该网络由 Ni36Fe64 元件（电线）组成，当受到铁磁共振（FMR）影响时，会产生小的自旋整流光电压。我们发现，自旋整流的效应可以建模为铁磁元件电阻的增加，并且紧密遵循串联和并联电路中总网络电阻的通常依赖性：串联铁磁线中的总自旋整流光电压等于各根线贡献的代数和，而在并联连接中，需要加上各根贡献的倒数。我们的结果支持一种简单的方法来控制和操纵多元件自旋电子器件中自旋整流光电压的大小。

full_list.title_en: Spin-Orbit-Torque-Driven Recurrent Motion of Synthetic Antiferromagnetic Skyrmions for Magnetic Clocking
full_list.title_zh: 用于磁时钟的合成反铁磁斯格明子的自旋轨道扭矩驱动循环运动
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.37014v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic skyrmions in synthetic antiferromagnets have emerged as attractive information carriers for spintronic technologies due to their compensated topology, which mitigates the skyrmion Hall effect and facilitates reliable current-driven transport. Here we present a frequency-tunable magnetic clocking concept based on the recurring translational motion of SAF skyrmions and define the material conditions needed to realize it in a Pt/Co/Ru/Pt/Co multilayer. Using micromagnetic simulations, we investigate the combined effects of interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction and interlayer Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida exchange coupling, delineating the parameter space in which coupled Néel-type skyrmions with opposite topological charges form a stable, topologically compensated pair. Under spin-orbit torque excitation, the SAF skyrmions exhibit resilient longitudinal transport with minimal transverse deflection using periodic boundary conditions. Periodic boundary conditions serve as an idealized model for closed-loop racetrack geometries, facilitating the study of continuous transport cycles and long-range steady-state dynamics. The oscillation frequency is readily modified by the applied current density and material characteristics, offering a pathway to field-free nanoscale timing components. Moreover, the threshold-activated initiation of recurrent transport mimics tonic-spiking behavior, indicating possible use in neuromorphic signal generation. This work establishes SAF skyrmions as versatile building elements for future spintronic functional devices by integrating topological protection, controllable transport, and cyclic dynamics.
full_list.abstract_zh: 合成反铁磁体中的磁性斯格明子因其补偿拓扑而成为自旋电子技术有吸引力的信息载体，可减轻斯格明子霍尔效应并促进可靠的电流驱动传输。在这里，我们提出了一种基于 SAF 斯格明子重复平移运动的频率可调磁时钟概念，并定义了在 Pt/Co/Ru/Pt/Co 多层中实现它所需的材料条件。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 合成反铁磁体中的磁性斯格明子因其补偿拓扑而成为自旋电子技术有吸引力的信息载体，可减轻斯格明子霍尔效应并促进可靠的电流驱动传输。在这里，我们提出了一种基于 SAF 斯格明子重复平移运动的频率可调磁时钟概念，并定义了在 Pt/Co/Ru/Pt/Co 多层中实现它所需的材料条件。利用微磁模拟，我们研究了界面 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用和层间 Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida 交换耦合的综合效应，描绘了具有相反拓扑电荷的耦合 Néel 型斯格明子形成稳定的拓扑补偿对的参数空间。在自旋轨道扭矩激励下，SAF 斯格明子在周期性边界条件下表现出弹性纵向传输和最小横向偏转。周期性边界条件作为闭环赛道几何形状的理想化模型，有助于连续传输循环和长程稳态动力学的研究。振荡频率很容易通过所施加的电流密度和材料特性进行修改，从而为无场纳米级计时组件提供了途径。此外，阈值激活的循环运输启动模仿了强直尖峰行为，表明可能用于神经形态信号生成。这项工作通过集成拓扑保护、可控输运和循环动力学，将 SAF 斯格明子确立为未来自旋电子功能器件的多功能构建元件。

full_list.title_en: Spin-polarized tunneling from a Kondo insulator: equilibrium surface magnetism versus magneto-electric response in SmB₆
full_list.title_zh: 近藤绝缘体的自旋极化隧道效应：SmB₆ 中的平衡表面磁性与磁电响应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36886v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically analyze the spin-polarized tunneling between SmB₆ tip and the bicollinear antiferromagnet Fe₁₊ₓTe. The emergence of magnetic contrast in tunneling requires time-reversal symmetry breaking on the surface of the tip. The magnetic contrast part of the tunneling conductance then has two contributions: the first one originates from the magnetic moment due to the equilibrium long-range order on the surface, while the other is governed by the magnetic moment induced by the electric field of the junction through the surface magneto-electric effect. We show that the ratio of the equilibrium moment to the response extracted near zero bias equals, up to the sign, twice the bias at which the contrast changes sign, independently of the relative strength of the two mechanisms, so that this ratio itself does not measure the strength of the magneto-electric effect. We find that within the experimental energy window |eV|lesssim10~meV the bias-dependent field-induced contribution is at most a few percent of the equilibrium one, and the two become comparable only at biases of order 100~meV or higher. The ratio of the field-induced to the equilibrium contribution is inversely proportional to the distance between the tip and the substrate.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们从理论上分析了 SmB₆ 尖端和双共线反铁磁体 Fe₁₊ₓTe 之间的自旋极化隧道效应。隧道效应中磁对比的出现需要尖端表面的时间反转对称性破缺。隧道电导的磁对比部分有两个贡献：第一个源于表面平衡长程有序产生的磁矩，而另一个则由结电场通过表面磁电效应感应的磁矩控制。我们表明，平衡矩与在零偏差附近提取的响应的比率等于对比度改变符号时偏差的两倍，与两种机制的相对强度无关，因此该比率本身并不能测量磁电效应的强度。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们从理论上分析了 SmB₆ 尖端和双共线反铁磁体 Fe₁₊ₓTe 之间的自旋极化隧道效应。隧道效应中磁对比的出现需要尖端表面的时间反转对称性破缺。隧道电导的磁对比部分有两个贡献：第一个源于表面平衡长程有序产生的磁矩，而另一个则由结电场通过表面磁电效应感应的磁矩控制。我们表明，平衡矩与在零偏差附近提取的响应的比率等于对比度改变符号时偏差的两倍，与两种机制的相对强度无关，因此该比率本身并不能测量磁电效应的强度。我们发现，在实验能量窗口 |eV|lesssim10~meV 内，偏置相关的场感应贡献最多仅为平衡场感应贡献的百分之几，并且只有在偏置达到 100~meV 或更高量级时，两者才具有可比性。场感应与平衡贡献的比率与尖端和基底之间的距离成反比。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《近藤绝缘体的自旋极化隧道效应：SmB₆ 中的平衡表面磁性与磁电响应》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Spontaneous topological diode effect induced by non-coplanar antiferromagnetic order
full_list.title_zh: 非共面反铁磁序引起的自发拓扑二极管效应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.37003v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In non-centrosymmetric bulk materials, electrons flowing in the opposite directions often exhibit different properties. This diode-like effect (i.e., non-reciprocal electron transport) typically originates from relativistic spin-orbit coupling, and its amplitude scales with external magnetic field or magnetization in ferromagnets. Although such rectification is usually absent in antiferromagnets at zero field, recent theories predict that non-coplanar antiferromagnetic order can host large non-reciprocity even without spin-orbit coupling, magnetization or external magnetic fields. This phenomenon - the spontaneous topological diode effect - can potentially be used for efficient electrical readout of antiferromagnetic domains, while it has not been verified for real materials. Here, we report the observation of this effect in a chiral-lattice non-coplanar antiferromagnet CoTa3S6. Nonlinear resistivity measurements reveal the non reciprocal nature of electron transport along the [001] direction at zero field. The observed non-reciprocity exceeds that in typical ferromagnets, whose amplitude is governed by antiferromagnetic order parameter rather than magnetization. First-principles calculations show that the non-coplanar antiferromagnetic order induces asymmetric band dispersions even without spin-orbit coupling, establishing the non-relativistic origin of the observed response. The present findings demonstrate a new mechanism for efficient electrical readout of antiferromagnetic domains, and highlight non-coplanar antiferromagnets as a promising material platform for realizing ferromagnet-like functional responses without relying on spin-orbit coupling or magnetization.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在非中心对称块体材料中，沿相反方向流动的电子通常表现出不同的特性。这种类似二极管的效应（即非互易电子传输）通常源于相对论自旋轨道耦合，其振幅与外部磁场或铁磁体中的磁化强度成比例。尽管这种整流在零场的反铁磁体中通常不存在，但最近的理论预测，即使没有自旋轨道耦合、磁化或外部磁场，非共面反铁磁有序也可以具有很大的非互易性。这种现象——自发拓扑二极管效应——有可能用于反铁磁域的有效电读出，但尚未在真实材料中得到验证。

full_list.title_en: STEM-Bank-26: An Open Dataset of Analytical Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy Images and Spectra
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：STEM-Bank-26: An Open Dataset of Analytical Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy Images and Spectra
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36086v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) is a versatile, multi-modal method for studying materials at the nanoscale. It integrates multiple signal sources to provide atomic resolution imaging alongside spectroscopy for elemental composition and electronic structure. Despite its utility, few datasets spanning multiple years of data have been published. We introduce STEM-Bank-26, a 929 GB open dataset of 37,921 STEM images that spans 1,095 material samples across 1,499 sessions and includes energy-dispersive spectroscopy (EDS) or electron-energy loss spectroscopy (EELS) data for 65.5% of sessions. We extract microscope control trajectories by comparing metadata between sequential images and provide tools for building similar datasets from archival data. To our knowledge, this is the largest openly available dataset that integrates experimental STEM, EDS and EELS data across a broad distribution of samples and sessions.

full_list.title_en: Stripe antiferromagnetic order and spin dynamics in the Shastry-Sutherland Ising compound Er2Be2GeO7
full_list.title_zh: Shastry-Sutherland Ising 化合物 Er2Be2GeO7 中的条纹反铁磁序和自旋动力学
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36799v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In rare-earth compounds, the interplay between geometric frustration and unusual single-ion anisotropy caused by the crystal electric field often leads to exotic magnetic phases. Here, we investigate the magnetic properties of the rare-earth Shastry-Sutherland compound Er₂Be₂GeO₇ using bulk measurements and neutron scattering down to sub-Kelvin temperatures. A k=(0,0,0) stripe-like antiferromagnetic order with locally tilted Er³⁺ moments is revealed by time-of-flight neutron powder diffraction, accompanied with a λ-shape specific-heat anomaly at T_N=0.84 K. The temperature dependence of the magnetic peak intensity corresponding to the ordered moment of Er³⁺ approximates to the two-dimensional Ising universality class. Thermal- and cold-neutron inelastic scattering experiments demonstrate that the strong Ising anisotropy originates from the local crystal electric field, and reveal gapped magnetic excitations with weak dispersion in the ordered state. Mean-field random-phase approximation with inequivalent nearest-neighbor couplings accounts well for the collective excitations, while classical Monte Carlo simulations yield the fractional 1/4 and 1/2 magnetization plateaus. Our work provides a comprehensive description of the spin correlations in Er₂Be₂GeO₇ with a particular focus on the classical origin of its fractional magnetization plateaus.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在稀土化合物中，晶体电场引起的几何挫败和不寻常的单离子各向异性之间的相互作用通常会导致奇异的磁相。在这里，我们使用体积测量和低至亚开尔文温度的中子散射来研究稀土 Shastry-Sutherland 化合物 Er2Be2GeO₇ 的磁性。飞行时间中子粉末衍射揭示了具有局部倾斜Er3⁺矩的k=(0,0,0)条状反铁磁序，并伴随着T_N=0.84 K处的λ形比热异常。Er3⁺有序矩对应的磁峰强度的温度依赖性近似于二维伊辛普适性类。

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Shastry-Sutherland Ising 化合物 Er2Be2GeO7 中的条纹反铁磁序和自旋动力学》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Three-dimensional quantum Hall insulators in magnetic pyrochlore systems
full_list.title_zh: 磁性烧绿石系统中的三维量子霍尔绝缘体
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36199v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that a class of pyrochlore materials provides a route to realize 3D Quantum Hall insulators, based on magnetic texture and flat band interference. We study itinerant electrons on a pyrochlore lattice Kondo-coupled to localized moments living on another interpenetrating pyrochlore lattice, with the moments forming a field-selected three-in/one-out texture. The noncoplanar texture generates complex spin-dependent hopping amplitudes and unequal local exchange energies, reconstructing the compact-localized parent flat bands into narrow bands separated by a global three-dimensional gap. The low-energy states are concentrated predominantly on kagome planes within the three-dimensional lattice, reflecting the combined effects of quantum interference and the texture-induced sublattice potential. When the lowest band is fully occupied, the response is characterized by a Chern triplet C=(1,1,1) and reciprocal Hall vector GH=(2π/a)(1,1,1), giving σyz=σzₓ=σₓy=e²/(ha). The quantized bulk Hall response enforces chiral surface spectral flow, visible as noncontractible Fermi loops at the surface. Our work opens a new direction in the search for three-dimensional quantum Hall physics in magnetic pyrochlore systems, and suggests a broad design principle based on the interplay of magnetic texture and flat-band interference.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们展示了一类烧绿石材料提供了一种基于磁性纹理和平带干涉来实现 3D 量子霍尔绝缘体的途径。我们研究了烧绿石晶格上的巡回电子与另一个互穿烧绿石晶格上的局部矩的近藤耦合，这些矩形成了场选择的三进一出纹理。非共面纹理产生复杂的自旋相关跳跃幅度和不等的局部交换能量，将紧凑局部的母平带重建为由全局三维间隙分隔的窄带。低能态主要集中在三维晶格内的戈薇平面上，反映了量子干涉和织构引起的亚晶格势的综合效应。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们展示了一类烧绿石材料提供了一种基于磁性纹理和平带干涉来实现 3D 量子霍尔绝缘体的途径。我们研究了烧绿石晶格上的巡回电子与另一个互穿烧绿石晶格上的局部矩的近藤耦合，这些矩形成了场选择的三进一出纹理。非共面纹理产生复杂的自旋相关跳跃幅度和不等的局部交换能量，将紧凑局部的母平带重建为由全局三维间隙分隔的窄带。低能态主要集中在三维晶格内的戈薇平面上，反映了量子干涉和织构引起的亚晶格势的综合效应。当最低频带被完全占据时，响应的特征为陈三元组 C=(1,1,1) 和倒数霍尔向量 GH=(2π/a)(1,1,1)，给出 σyz=σzₓ=σₓy=e²/(ha)。量子化的体霍尔响应增强了手性表面光谱流，在表面可见为不可收缩的费米环。我们的工作为磁性烧绿石系统中三维量子霍尔物理的探索开辟了新的方向，并提出了基于磁性纹理和平带干涉相互作用的广泛设计原理。
