full_list.title_en: Topologically Protected Surface Altermagnetism on Antiferromagnets
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Topologically Protected Surface Altermagnetism on Antiferromagnets
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2602.10108v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnetism (AM) and its associated spin-transport phenomena are typically linked to spin-split electronic band structures in bulk materials. However, the crystal surface has a reduced symmetry with respect to the bulk, which can induce AM at the surface of conventional antiferromagnets (AFMs) unicodex2013 a local effect which cannot be detected using bulk properties. In this work we define the symmetry conditions necessary for surface AM and show how it can be topologically protected, rendering it a robust effect. We provide a minimal model for one trivial and two topological examples of surface AM. We show that the spin spectral density, accessible by spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, can exhibit a d-wave-like altermagnetic character at the surface, even when the full band structure is completely spin degenerate. Our topological model describes the Dirac semimetal CuMnAs, which provides an existing realization of our theory. Our results identify crystal surfaces as a platform to realize robust, topology- and symmetry-driven unconventional magnetism beyond the bulk classification of magnetic materials.

full_list.title_en: Unconventional SOC-activated Altermagnetic Spin Splitting and Half-Angle Locking of Spin Transport
full_list.title_zh: 非常规 SOC 激活的交变磁自旋分裂和自旋输运的半角锁定
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.37367v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conventional altermagnetic spin splitting arises from staggered exchange and sublattice-dependent anisotropic hopping without requiring spin-orbit coupling (SOC). Here we derive a low-energy effective model showing that SOC and staggered exchange can jointly activate additional spin splitting on momentum planes where the nonrelativistic contribution vanishes. In hexagonal α-MnTe, this SOC-activated contribution produces d-wave spin splitting near Γ with out-of-plane spin polarization. Its leading angular pattern counter-rotates by half the in-plane Néel-vector rotation angle. First-principles spin-transport calculations reveal a corresponding approximate half-angle locking between the Néel-vector orientation and the electric-field directions maximizing the signed longitudinal and transverse spin conductivities. Analytical transport calculations based on the effective model trace this locking to the same angular coupling between momentum and the Néel vector that governs the spin-splitting pattern. Our findings connect the microscopic mechanism of SOC-activated altermagnetic spin splitting to directional spin transport, providing a theoretical basis for probing Néel-vector orientation and controlling spin-current generation.
full_list.abstract_zh: 传统的变磁自旋分裂产生于交错交换和亚晶格相关的各向异性跳跃，而不需要自旋轨道耦合（ SOC ）。在这里，我们推导出一个低能量有效模型，表明SOC和交错交换可以在非相对论贡献消失的动量平面上联合激活额外的自旋分裂。在六边形α-MnTe中，这种SOC激活的贡献在Γ附近产生具有平面外自旋极化的d波自旋分裂。其前角图案反转一半的平面内Néel-矢量旋转角。第一原理自旋传输计算揭示了Néel-矢量取向和电场方向之间的相应近似半角锁定，最大化了有符号的纵向和横向自旋电导率。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 传统的变磁自旋分裂产生于交错交换和亚晶格相关的各向异性跳跃，而不需要自旋轨道耦合（ SOC ）。在这里，我们推导出一个低能量有效模型，表明SOC和交错交换可以在非相对论贡献消失的动量平面上联合激活额外的自旋分裂。在六边形α-MnTe中，这种SOC激活的贡献在Γ附近产生具有平面外自旋极化的d波自旋分裂。其前角图案反转一半的平面内Néel-矢量旋转角。第一原理自旋传输计算揭示了Néel-矢量取向和电场方向之间的相应近似半角锁定，最大化了有符号的纵向和横向自旋电导率。基于有效模型的分析传输计算将这种锁定追溯到动量与控制自旋分裂模式的Néel矢量之间的相同角耦合。我们的发现将SOC激活的改变磁自旋分裂的微观机制与定向自旋传输联系起来，为探测Néel矢量取向和控制自旋电流生成提供了理论基础。

full_list.title_en: ZnO/Ni interface-activated enhancement of spintronic terahertz emission from Ni/Pt bilayers
full_list.title_zh: ZnO/Ni 界面激活增强 Ni/Pt 双层自旋电子太赫兹发射
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36889v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spintronic terahertz (THz) emitters based on ferromagnet/heavy-metal bilayers provide an efficient route for generating broadband THz radiation through ultrafast spin-to-charge conversion. However, Ni/Pt bilayers usually exhibit relatively weak THz emission, limiting their use as efficient spintronic emitters. Here, we report an interface-assisted enhancement of THz emission in ZnO/Ni/Pt heterostructures. By placing ZnO underneath Ni while preserving the direct Ni/Pt contact, the THz amplitude is increased by up to approximately 2.8 times compared with the Ni/Pt reference. The enhanced emission reverses polarity with the magnetic field and follows the expected angular dependence of ultrafast spin-to-charge conversion. ZnO-, Ni-, and Pt-thickness-dependent measurements show that the emission remains governed by the Ni/Pt conversion process but is strongly affected by the ZnO/Ni bottom interface. Control samples with Al2O3, Cu, and Fe further exclude a simple underlayer, optical, or growth-quality origin. The enhancement is attributed to a short-range ZnO/Ni interface effect, possibly involving oxygen-related defects, interfacial electric fields, and modification of the Ni interfacial state. This work provides a semiconductor/ferromagnet interface-engineering strategy for activating weak Ni/Pt spintronic THz emitters.
full_list.abstract_zh: 基于铁磁体/重金属双层的自旋电子太赫兹（THz）发射器为通过超快自旋电荷转换产生宽带太赫兹辐射提供了有效的途径。然而，Ni/Pt双层通常表现出相对较弱的太赫兹发射，限制了它们作为高效自旋电子发射器的用途。在这里，我们报告了 ZnO/Ni/Pt 异质结构中太赫兹发射的界面辅助增强。通过将 ZnO 放置在 Ni 下方，同时保留 Ni/Pt 直接接触，与 Ni/Pt 参考相比，太赫兹振幅最多增加约 2.8 倍。增强的发射通过磁场反转极性，并遵循超快自旋到电荷转换的预期角度依赖性。

full_list.title_en: Bidirectional motion of antiferromagnetic skyrmions driven by competing spin torques
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Bidirectional motion of antiferromagnetic skyrmions driven by competing spin torques
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2606.18657v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Antiferromagnetic skyrmions are swirling topological spin textures with rich dynamics and intriguing transport properties, yet their bidirectional dynamics remain largely unexplored. Here, we investigate the dynamics of antiferromagnetic skyrmions driven by current-induced spin-transfer and spin-orbit torques. We computationally demonstrate that antiferromagnetic skyrmions moving in one direction at low current densities can reverse their motion direction when the driving current is above a threshold. Based on the Thiele approach analysis, we show that this bidirectional motion originates from a change in the relative strengths of two effective forces arising from spin-transfer and spin-orbit torques. Furthermore, exploiting this bidirectional motion on a single racetrack, we design programmable logic gates. Our results not only uncover a hidden mechanism for bidirectional skyrmion motion but also facilitate the development of antiferromagnet-based logic devices.

full_list.title_en: Emergent energy scales in magnonic systems with relative motion
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Emergent energy scales in magnonic systems with relative motion
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2606.29316v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Relative motion between interacting systems can generate emergent energy scales that are absent in isolated systems. While uniform motion can be eliminated by a Galilean transformation, relative motion between interacting systems generally cannot. By coupling to an excitation's spatial structure, relative motion generates a Doppler frequency determined by its wavevector and the relative velocity, providing a mechanism for driving nonequilibrium phenomena. In this tutorial, we illustrate these ideas using magnonic systems as a concrete platform. We first discuss motion-induced magnon transport between relatively moving ferromagnets, in which the Doppler frequency serves as an effective nonequilibrium bias in the perturbative regime. This mechanism produces magnon currents even without conventional driving forces such as temperature gradients or chemical potential differences. We then introduce motion-induced parametric instabilities. When the emergent scale becomes sufficiently large to resonantly create magnon pairs, the perturbative description breaks down, and the magnonic vacuum becomes unstable. This instability occurs above a critical velocity threshold and leads to spontaneous magnon-pair creation. Connections to related phenomena, including quantum friction, Cherenkov emission, and Zel'dovich superradiance, are also highlighted. The concept of an emergent energy scale provides a unifying framework for understanding transport phenomena and instabilities in quantum systems with relative motion.

full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Emergent energy scales in magnonic systems with relative motion》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Magnetic Field Control of the Néel Vector and Magnon Visibility in Altermagnetic MnTe
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Magnetic Field Control of the Néel Vector and Magnon Visibility in Altermagnetic MnTe
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2607.08829v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnetic order gives rise to momentum-dependent spin splitting of electronic and magnonic excitations even in the absence of a net magnetization. Here, we investigate the magnetic field dependence of the spin-wave spectrum of altermagnetic α-MnTe using inelastic neutron scattering and linear spin-wave theory. An in-plane magnetic field continuously reorients the Néel vector by overcoming the weak crystalline anisotropy, while remaining small compared with the dominant exchange scale. We find that this reorientation leaves the magnon energies and line widths essentially unchanged, but strongly modifies the measured spectral intensity through the transverse-momentum projection. Our results demonstrate a clear separation between the soft orientational degree of freedom of the antiferromagnetic order and the robust exchange-dominated chiral magnon spectrum. This combination establishes α-MnTe as a platform for reconfigurable magnon coupling, in which external fields tune how excitations interact with polarized probes without substantially altering their frequency or coherence.

full_list.title_en: Wavefunction-templated metamaterials
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Wavefunction-templated metamaterials
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.37248v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Metamaterials, which store, guide and emit waves through their eigenmodes, have enabled the development of devices with unprecedented functionalities. Yet the spatial profiles of conventional metamaterials' eigenmodes are typically determined by their pre-determined structures (Hamiltonians). In this work, we introduce `wavefunction-templated metamaterials', a class of physically realizable metamaterials hosting diverse prescribed, spectrally isolated eigenstates. The resulting Hamiltonian geometries obey a boundary law, with the required nonlocality determined solely by single-contact boundary sites, independent of the state interior or lattice size. The sparse Hamiltonians are then Hermitianized, followed by spectral reshaping to open a protective gap around the target eigenstate. We validate our approach in discrete lattices and acoustic metamaterials. Although demonstrated in acoustics, the principle can be applied to thermal, electrical-circuit and photonic metamaterials.

full_list.title_en: Crystal forming ability of amorphous refractory metals under nanoindentation: a molecular dynamics study
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Crystal forming ability of amorphous refractory metals under nanoindentation: a molecular dynamics study
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2607.26881v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Amorphous refractory metal coatings combine high hardness with chemical inertness, yet their metastability makes them prone to mechanically induced crystallisation (devitrification) under contact loading, and how readily such a glass re-orders to its parent body centred cubic (bcc) crystal is unknown across the refractory series. We prepared amorphous V, Nb, Mo, Ta and W by melt quenching to 300 K, benchmarked each interatomic potential against ab initio liquid radial distribution functions and self-diffusion coefficients, and probed them by large scale molecular dynamics nanoindentation. Indentation drives a localised amorphous to bcc transformation by bulk nucleation, growth and coalescence. A crystal forming ability (CFA), the maximum slope of the sigmoidal bcc fraction versus depth curve, spans about a factor of four and decreases as V > Mo > Nb > Ta > W; it falls with indenter velocity as CFA scales as v⁽⁻m⁾, with a mean exponent of 1.08, so CFA.v is nearly constant and the transformation rate is almost velocity independent. Transforming atoms carry excess non affine displacement and local shear strain, not hydrostatic pressure, marking a shear associated displacive pathway; the bulk driving force is largest for the most resistant element, W, so resistance tracks cohesive bond strength rather than the thermodynamic driving force. Early bcc like order correlates with the sharpness and depth of the transition, whereas the mechanical work to half transformation correlates with the peak density of persistent bcc clusters. A cluster population balance links nucleation, growth and coalescence to a terminal microstructure whose completeness does not follow the CFA order.

full_list.title_en: Magnons in α-Fe2O3 microdisks: from thermal to coherent excitation
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Magnons in α-Fe2O3 microdisks: from thermal to coherent excitation
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.37205v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hematite is a prototypical antiferromagnetic insulator for spintronic and magnonic applications, yet controlled studies of coherent magnons in thin films remain challenging due to strain sensitivity and spatial inhomogeneity. Here, we investigate magnon excitations in lithographically patterned hematite microdisks, and obtain reproducible magnon spectra from multiple individual microdisks. Brillouin light scattering reveals bulk-like field-dependent thermal magnon resonances with an ultralow effective damping parameter on the order of ~10-5. Coherent magnons are further excited using a stripline antenna adjacent to the microdisk, revealing a power-dependent frequency blue shift accompanied by a nonlinear evolution of the coherent response under strong microwave driving. Field-dependent analysis indicates a power-dependent increase of the effective magnetic anisotropy field, suggesting a tunable nonlinear response of antiferromagnetic magnons in laterally confined microdisks. These results establish patterned hematite thin films as a platform for exploring coherent and nonlinear antiferromagnetic magnon dynamics.

full_list.title_en: Quantum structured light: Non-classical spin texture of twisted single-photon pulses
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Quantum structured light: Non-classical spin texture of twisted single-photon pulses
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2102.13248v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Classical structured light with controlled polarization and orbital angular momentum (OAM) of electromagnetic waves has varied applications in optical trapping, bio-sensing, optical communications and quantum simulations. The classical electromagnetic theory of such structured light beams and pulses have advanced significantly over the last two decades. However, a framework for the quantum density of spin and OAM for single-photons remains elusive. Here, we develop a theoretical framework and put forth the concept of quantum structured light for space-time wavepackets at the single-photon level. Our work marks a paradigm shift beyond scalar-field theory as well as the paraxial approximation and can be utilized to study the quantum properties of the spin and OAM of all classes of twisted quantum light pulses. We capture the uncertainty in full three-dimensional (3D) projections of vector spin demonstrating their quantum behavior beyond the conventional concept of classical polarization. Even in laser beams with high OAM along the propagation direction, we predict the existence of large OAM quantum fluctuations in the transverse plane which can be verified experimentally. We show that the spin density generates modulated helical texture beyond the paraxial limit and exhibits distinct statistics for Fock-state vs. coherent-state twisted pulses. We introduce the quantum correlator of photon spin density to characterize the nonlocal spin noise providing a rigorous parallel with fermionic spin noise operators. Our work paves the way for quantum spin-OAM physics in twisted single photon pulses and also opens explorations for new phases of light with long-range spin order.

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Quantum structured light: Non-classical spin texture of twisted single-photon pulses》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Learning Multiscale Dynamics of Nanoparticle Self-Assembly
full_list.title_zh: 学习纳米粒子自组装的多尺度动力学
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36498v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nanoparticle self-assembly offers a powerful route to programmable functional materials, but its dynamics remain difficult to understand because they arise from multiscale, many-body, and environment-dependent interactions. Liquid-phase transmission electron microscopy (LPTEM) enables real-time observation of these dynamics, yet extracting the underlying physical laws from highly stochastic trajectories remains a significant challenge. Here we develop a physics-informed, time-varying autoregressive framework that learns multiscale self-assembly dynamics directly from LPTEM videos. Continuous Eulerian fields with local density and orientational order are coarse-grained from individual video frames and evolved by a sparse, nearest-neighbor operator optimized over a constrained matrix manifold. This interpretable approach captures long-time large scale phase transitions by tracking operator volatility over time, and short-timescale local evolution and transport rules. Crucially, we extract the underlying partial differential equations, where expected symmetries naturally emerge, enabling the direct inference of fundamental coefficients. Our framework provides a robust, computationally efficient tool for discovering hidden physical mechanisms from observational data, opening a path toward the predictive design of self-assembled nanostructures.
full_list.abstract_zh: 纳米粒子自组装为可编程功能材料提供了一条强大的途径，但其动力学仍然难以理解，因为它们是由多尺度、多体和环境依赖的相互作用产生的。液相透射电子显微镜（LPTEM）能够实时观察这些动力学，但从高度随机的轨迹中提取潜在的物理定律仍然是一个重大挑战。在这里，我们开发了一个基于物理的时变自回归框架，可以直接从 LPTEM 视频中学习多尺度自组装动力学。具有局部密度和方向顺序的连续欧拉场是由各个视频帧粗粒度化的，并由在约束矩阵流形上优化的稀疏最近邻算子演化而来。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 纳米粒子自组装为可编程功能材料提供了一条强大的途径，但其动力学仍然难以理解，因为它们是由多尺度、多体和环境依赖的相互作用产生的。液相透射电子显微镜（LPTEM）能够实时观察这些动力学，但从高度随机的轨迹中提取潜在的物理定律仍然是一个重大挑战。在这里，我们开发了一个基于物理的时变自回归框架，可以直接从 LPTEM 视频中学习多尺度自组装动力学。具有局部密度和方向顺序的连续欧拉场是由各个视频帧粗粒度化的，并由在约束矩阵流形上优化的稀疏最近邻算子演化而来。这种可解释的方法通过跟踪算子随时间的波动性以及短时间尺度的局部演化和传输规则来捕获长时间的大规模相变。至关重要的是，我们提取了潜在的偏微分方程，其中预期的对称性自然出现，从而能够直接推断基本系数。我们的框架提供了一个强大的、计算高效的工具，用于从观测数据中发现隐藏的物理机制，为自组装纳米结构的预测设计开辟了道路。

full_list.title_en: A cascade of orbital-field-driven phases with a Lifshitz-type transition to unidirectional spiral order
full_list.title_zh: 轨道场驱动相的级联，具有 Lifshitz 型过渡到单向螺旋顺序
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36214v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Frustration in magnetic systems gives rise to unconventional orders and exotic spin liquids. Here, we explore a new type of frustration arising from an intrinsic bond-dependent orbital-field that couples orbital degrees of freedom to spin correlations. Introducing this orbital-field interaction into the antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model on the honeycomb lattice, we show that local spin-orbital constraints generate a subextensive degeneracy, lifted by order-by-disorder to select distinct collinear magnets in a cascade of phases as the orbital field increases from a para-orbital liquid. At larger fields, the selected phase gives way to an incommensurate unidirectional spiral that spontaneously breaks chiral symmetry. This transition is driven by the coupling of a Goldstone mode to gapped dynamical spin-orbital fluctuations. The spin stiffness becomes negative along a particular direction, while the spiral wavevector grows as the square root of the distance from the transition, signaling a Lifshitz-type transition. We present a microscopic route to realizing this orbital field and discuss candidate materials.
full_list.abstract_zh: 磁系统中的挫败会产生非常规有序和奇异的自旋液体。在这里，我们探索了一种新型的挫败感，这种挫败感是由内在的键相关轨道场产生的，该轨道场将轨道自由度与自旋相关性耦合起来。将这种轨道场相互作用引入蜂窝晶格的反铁磁海森堡模型中，我们表明，局部自旋轨道约束会产生次广泛的简并性，随着轨道场从准轨道液体增加，通过逐序提升，以在级联中选择不同的共线磁体。在较大的场中，选定的相让位于不相称的单向螺旋，该螺旋会自发地破坏手性对称性。这种转变是由戈德斯通模式与带隙动态自旋轨道涨落的耦合驱动的。

full_list.title_en: A Hybrid Brownian Dynamics-kinetic Monte Carlo Framework for Coupled Magnetic and Rotational Dynamics of Nanoparticles
full_list.title_zh: 用于纳米颗粒耦合磁和旋转动力学的混合布朗动力学-动力学蒙特卡罗框架
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36102v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Simulating the coupled magnetic and rotational dynamics of suspended magnetic nanoparticles (MNPs) over experimentally relevant timescales remains computationally demanding, particularly under low-frequency alternating magnetic fields. Here, we develop a hybrid Brownian Dynamics--kinetic Monte Carlo (BD--kMC) framework that combines thermally activated magnetic switching with particle rotation while retaining local fluctuations of the magnetic moment. These fluctuations are incorporated through Metropolis Monte Carlo (MC) sampling, allowing the moment to depart from the energy minima and thereby capturing the thermally averaged anisotropy torque that governs particle rotation. To preserve the distinction between local fluctuations and magnetic reversals, a barrier-trapping criterion confines MC trial moves to the current energy well, leaving thermally activated switching to the kMC process. For non-interacting single-domain MNPs, comparison with stochastic Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert (LLG) simulations demonstrates agreement in the equilibrium torque and stationary easy-axis orientation, including the field-driven transition from predominantly perpendicular to parallel alignment. The resulting BD--kMC framework provides an efficient approach to coupled magnetic and Brownian Dynamics, reducing the computational cost of exploring the long timescales relevant to low-frequency magnetic applications.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在实验相关时间尺度上模拟悬浮磁性纳米颗粒 (MNP) 的耦合磁性和旋转动力学仍然需要大量计算，特别是在低频交变磁场下。在这里，我们开发了一种混合布朗动力学-动力学蒙特卡罗（BD--kMC）框架，该框架将热激活磁开关与粒子旋转相结合，同时保留磁矩的局部波动。这些波动通过 Metropolis Monte Carlo (MC) 采样纳入，允许力矩偏离能量最小值，从而捕获控制粒子旋转的热平均各向异性扭矩。

full_list.title_en: A pathway to improve Nb₃Sn for SRF accelerator cavities via Zr inclusion
full_list.title_zh: 通过Zr包裹改善SRF加速器腔的Nb ”Sn”的途径
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36479v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Nb₃Sn has the potential to exceed the performance of niobium-based superconducting radio-frequency (SRF) cavities, both in particle accelerators and in high-Q₀ cavities operating in multi-tesla magnetic fields for axion dark matter searches. We studied how the incorporation of Zr into the Nb₃Sn matrix by co-sputtering affects the microstructure and superconducting properties of Nb₃Sn films. As the atomic fraction of Zr increased, the surface morphology improved and the bulk and surface void densities decreased. At the optimal Zr content, the superconducting properties improved and a thinner surface niobium oxide formed. These results identify co-sputtered Nb₃Sn:Zr as a promising material to advance the performance limits of SRF cavities.
full_list.abstract_zh: 无论是在粒子加速器中还是在用于轴子暗物质搜索的多特斯拉磁场中运行的高Q值空腔中，铌基超导射频（ SRF ）空腔的性能都有可能超过铌基超导射频（ SRF ）空腔的性能。我们研究了通过共溅射将Zr掺入Nb + Sn基体中如何影响Nb + Sn薄膜的微观结构和超导性能。随着Zr原子分数的增加，表面形貌改善，体积和表面空隙密度降低。在最佳Zr含量下，超导性能得到改善，并形成较薄的表面氧化铌。这些结果表明，共溅射Nb ”Sn: Zr是一种有希望提高SRF腔体性能极限的材料。

full_list.title_en: Algebraic flat bands and even central-band Chern numbers in a seven-orbital hopping model
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Algebraic flat bands and even central-band Chern numbers in a seven-orbital hopping model
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36738v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Turning a flat-band parent into an isolated Chern band requires supervise of destructive interference, hopping phases, and the cell translations of the bonds. We study this connection in a seven-orbital 2 times 2 supercell honeycomb-vacancy lattice, combining analytic reductions with Bloch spectra, lattice Chern invariants, and quantum geometry. The parent lattice has three exact flat branches, a smooth periodic zero mode, and a compact localized state. A uniform gap bound shows that faint intracell-loop hopping preserves two topologically trivial insulating gaps. The intracell hopping graph also admits a staggered chiral coloring: reversing site amplitudes according to this coloring links opposite energies at momenta separated by half a reciprocal period. This constraint restricts the isolated central band to even Chern numbers and forbids a zero-energy insulating filling at every loop phase. Purely imaginary loop hopping admits a real gauge, whereas other phases allow paired band contacts connecting central bands with C3=2 and C3=4. On a specified strong-loop cut, third-order masses open the direct gaps; these gaps shrink faster than the bandwidth as the coupling grows. Changing the bond connectivity to an oriented honeycomb next-nearest-neighbor extension generates a narrower Chern band with nonuniform quantum geometry. These results distinguish individual-band topology from occupied-group topology and reveal how bond connectivity and cell translations determine which topological bands can emerge from an exactly flat parent.

full_list.title_en: AlgebrasTQD: Computing Algebras and Interfaces in Twisted Quantum Doubles
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：AlgebrasTQD: Computing Algebras and Interfaces in Twisted Quantum Doubles
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36029v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present AlgebrasTQD, an open-source code written in GAP (Groups, Algorithms, and Programming), for computing condensable algebras and the corresponding topological boundaries and interfaces of twisted quantum doubles D^ω(G). These algebras can be used to classify 1+1d gapped and gapless phases whose symmetry is related by gauging to a finite group G with anomaly ωin H³(G,U(1)), to study 2+1d anyon proliferation and to construct logical gates in non-Abelian topological quantum codes. The functions in AlgebrasTQD compute all condensable algebras A(H,F,γ,ϵ) with their algebra structure and anyons, sort them into isomorphism classes and identify the twin algebras that are inequivalent but share the same anyon decomposition. AlgebrasTQD also determines all the subalgebra relations, the corresponding Hasse diagram and the types of 1+1d phases for any chosen, possibly non-invertible, group-theoretical symmetry. For non-maximal algebras, the code computes the reduced topological order with its 3-cocycle and the map of anyons across the topological interface. Finally, AlgebrasTQD includes functions that construct certain non-Clifford logical gates via non-Abelian surface codes. We summarize the formulas that are implemented in the AlgebrasTQD code, and we illustrate its use with Abelian and non-Abelian groups including Z₂³ with ω_III, D₈, A₄ with and without anomaly, twin algebras and twin phases, and the Clifford-hierarchy gates in quantum doubles of dihedral groups. All arithmetic is exact and AlgebrasTQD can be used with any finite group G and 3-cocycle ω, limited only by the time and size of the calculation. The code is available at https://github.com/AlisonWarman/AlgebrasTQD

full_list.title_en: Anisotropic Structural and Magnetic Response in Sm₂Ir₈Al₃₁: Al-Sublattice Reconstruction upon Sm Substitution
full_list.title_zh: Sm2Ir₈Al₃₁ 中的各向异性结构和磁响应：Sm 取代后的 Al 亚晶格重构
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36140v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chemical pressure plays a critical role in determining the crystal structures and physical properties of intermetallic compounds. Here, we report the synthesis, crystal structure, and physical properties of Sm₂Ir₈Al₃₁, a structural analog of UIr₄Al₁₅, in which the smaller 5f uranium atoms are replaced by larger 4f samarium atoms. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction reveals a tetragonal sqrt2×sqrt2×1 superstructure with space group Pbar42₁m, derived from a UIr₄Al₁₅-like average structure with space group P4₂/nmc. Comparison with UIr₄Al₁₅ shows that chemical pressure from U-to-Sm substitution produces a strongly anisotropic structural response rather than a uniform expansion of the Ir-Al framework. While one Ir coordination environment undergoes only modest changes, the other exhibits substantial local rearrangement. The Al sublattice primarily accommodates these structural distortions, with selected Al sites showing positional splitting, anisotropic atomic displacement ellipsoids, and partial occupancies, resulting in an Al-rich composition of approximately Sm₂Ir₈Al₃₁. Magnetic susceptibility measurements reveal a direction dependence, including a broad anomaly near 50 K for selected magnetic-field orientations. However, the absence of corresponding anomalies in heat capacity, electrical resistivity, and lattice parameters suggests that this feature is more consistent with an anisotropic magnetic crossover than a bulk thermodynamic phase transition. These results highlight how chemical substitution at the f-element site can induce Al-sublattice reconstruction and modify the magnetic response within a closely related Ir-Al structural framework.
full_list.abstract_zh: 化学压力在确定金属间化合物的晶体结构和物理性质方面起着至关重要的作用。在这里，我们报道了 Sm2Ir8Al31 的合成、晶体结构和物理性质，Sm2Ir8Al31 是 UIr4Al15 的结构类似物，其中较小的 5f 铀原子被较大的 4f 钐原子取代。单晶X射线衍射揭示了空间群为Pbar42₁m的四方sqrt2×sqrt2×1超结构，源自空间群为P42/nmc的UIr4Al15类平均结构。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 化学压力在确定金属间化合物的晶体结构和物理性质方面起着至关重要的作用。在这里，我们报道了 Sm2Ir8Al31 的合成、晶体结构和物理性质，Sm2Ir8Al31 是 UIr4Al15 的结构类似物，其中较小的 5f 铀原子被较大的 4f 钐原子取代。单晶X射线衍射揭示了空间群为Pbar42₁m的四方sqrt2×sqrt2×1超结构，源自空间群为P42/nmc的UIr4Al15类平均结构。与 UIr4Al15 的比较表明，U 到 Sm 取代的化学压力产生了强烈的各向异性结构响应，而不是 Ir-Al 骨架的均匀膨胀。虽然一种 Ir 配位环境仅经历了适度的变化，但另一种则表现出大量的局部重排。 Al 亚晶格主要适应这些结构畸变，选定的 Al 位点表现出位置分裂、各向异性原子位移椭球和部分占据，从而形成大约 Sm2Ir8Al31 的富铝成分。磁化率测量揭示了方向依赖性，包括所选磁场方向在 50 K 附近的广泛异常。然而，热容量、电阻率和晶格参数中不存在相应的异常，这表明该特征与各向异性磁交叉比体热力学相变更一致。这些结果强调了 f 元素位点的化学取代如何诱导 Al 亚晶格重建并改变密切相关的 Ir-Al 结构框架内的磁响应。
full_list.summary: 化学压力在确定金属间化合物的晶体结构和物理性质方面起着至关重要的作用。在这里，我们报道了 Sm2Ir8Al31 的合成、晶体结构和物理性质，Sm2Ir8Al31 是 UIr4Al15 的结构类似物，其中较小的 5f 铀原子被较大的 4f 钐原子取代。单晶X射线衍射揭示了空间群为Pbar42₁m的四方sqrt2×sqrt2×1超结构，源自空间群为P42/nmc的UIr4Al15类平均结构。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：热力学自由能、相稳定与有限温度建模，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Sm2Ir₈Al₃₁ 中的各向异性结构和磁响应：Sm 取代后的 Al 亚晶格重构》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Antisymmetric thermopower without magnetism in three-phase composites
full_list.title_zh: 三相复合材料中无磁的反对称热电势
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36742v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A thermopower that turns a temperature gradient into a perpendicular electric field in every in-plane direction has relied on magnetism. Reciprocity permits it without magnetism, yet under a three-fold or higher axis it vanishes both in reciprocal elastic band transport and in composites of two isotropic phases with ideal interfaces. Here we show that composites of three isotropic phases carry it, and that under such an axis three is the minimum. A third, linearly independent transport matrix escapes the exact two-phase reduction; at weak contrast the first allowed axial term is cubic, proportional to a determinant of the three matrices times material-weighted, handed three-point correlations. Treating the phases as colours identifies the arrangements that allow the response, and crystal nets from reticular chemistry supply printable three-dimensional ones. Certified two-sided bounds give axial Seebeck coefficients of 49.5-50.2 μV K⁻¹ in a planar cell and 76-84 μV K⁻¹ in a printable woodpile; reflections in planes containing the axis reverse the response, and recolouring 24 nets to restore their parent symmetry switches it off. Around a line heat source the axial driving field has the 1/r azimuthal form of the magnetic field of a straight wire and drives circulating currents.
full_list.abstract_zh: 将温度梯度转变为每个面内方向的垂直电场的热电势依赖于磁性。互易性允许它没有磁性，但在三倍或更高的轴下，它在互易弹性带输运和具有理想界面的两个各向同性相的复合材料中消失。在这里，我们表明三个各向同性相的复合材料携带它，并且在这样的轴下三个是最小的。第三个线性独立的传输矩阵逃脱了精确的两相约简；在弱对比度下，第一个允许的轴项是三次，与三个矩阵的行列式乘以材料加权、手三点相关性成正比。将相作为颜色来识别允许响应的排列，并且来自网状化学的晶体网提供可打印的三维晶体网。

full_list.title_en: Confinement, registry and spin in chromium migration between graphene layers
full_list.title_zh: 石墨烯层之间铬迁移的限制、注册和自旋
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36197v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We compare the migration of a single Cr atom on monolayer graphene, between AB-stacked layers and between AA-stacked layers, with one first-principles protocol (PBE+D3(BJ), one cell family, registry anchors and spin-state search). We find three main results. First, on the surface and in the AB gallery Cr stays magnetic and moves almost freely. On the surface the C-C bridge is the minimum in 4x4 and 5x5 cells, and the highest point we sample on a hop lies 10 meV above it (5x5). In the AB gallery Cr sits on the inversion centres of the bilayer, which form a kagome net, and hops between them over 15 meV with a moment of about 4.32 μ_B. Second, in the AA gallery the minimum is a nonmagnetic η⁶-η⁶ sandwich that pulls the layers together. Leaving it requires opening the gallery and switching Cr to a moment of 4-5 μ_B, so we map the path with separately relaxed spin branches. The barrier estimate is 636 meV in a 3x3 cell but 260 and 185 meV in 5x5 cells with the far-field spacing pinned and free, and it is not yet converged. At 300 K, with equal prefactors and if the spin change is not rate-limiting, Cr hops between AA layers 3-4 orders of magnitude more slowly than between AB layers, using the 5x5 AA estimates and the 3x3 AB band. These AA numbers are specific to PBE+D3: an on-site U of 1.0 eV on Cr d already makes the magnetic states the AA ground state. Third, Cr binds 246-666 meV more strongly in AA than in AB registry, so the fast AB hop requires that the layers keep their Bernal registry around Cr.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们将单个 Cr 原子在单层石墨烯上、AB 堆叠层之间和 AA 堆叠层之间的迁移与一个第一原理协议（PBE+D3(BJ)、一个细胞族、注册表锚点和自旋状态搜索）进行比较。我们发现三个主要结果。首先，在表面和 AB 廊道中，Cr 保持磁性并且几乎可以自由移动。从表面上看，C-C 桥在 4x4 和 5x5 单元中是最小的，我们在一次跳跃中采样的最高点位于其上方 10 meV (5x5)。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们将单个 Cr 原子在单层石墨烯上、AB 堆叠层之间和 AA 堆叠层之间的迁移与一个第一原理协议（PBE+D3(BJ)、一个细胞族、注册表锚点和自旋状态搜索）进行比较。我们发现三个主要结果。首先，在表面和 AB 廊道中，Cr 保持磁性并且几乎可以自由移动。从表面上看，C-C 桥在 4x4 和 5x5 单元中是最小的，我们在一次跳跃中采样的最高点位于其上方 10 meV (5x5)。在 AB 画廊中，Cr 位于双层的反转中心，形成戈薇网，并在它们之间跳跃超过 15 meV，矩约为 4.32 μ_B。其次，在 AA 画廊中，最小的是非磁性 η⁶-η⁶ 三明治，它将各层拉在一起。离开它需要打开画廊并将 Cr 切换到 4-5 μ_B 的时刻，因此我们用单独松弛的自旋分支来映射路径。 3x3 单元中的势垒估计为 636 meV，但 5x5 单元中的势垒估计为 260 和 185 meV，远场间距固定且自由，并且尚未收敛。在 300 K 下，在相同的前因数且自旋变化不受速率限制的情况下，使用 5x5 AA 估计和 3x3 AB 频带，Cr 在 AA 层之间的跳跃速度比 AB 层之间慢 3-4 个数量级。这些 AA 数特定于 PBE+D3：Cr d 上 1.0 eV 的现场 U 已经使磁态成为 AA 基态。第三，Cr 在 AA 中比在 AB 注册表中更牢固地结合 246-666 meV，因此快速 AB 跳跃要求各层将其 Bernal 注册表保持在 Cr 周围。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：第一性原理标注与结构优化，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《石墨烯层之间铬迁移的限制、注册和自旋》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Detailed balance and phase transition in Nash equilibria of mean-field Ising game
full_list.title_zh: 均值场Ising博弈的纳什均衡的详细平衡和相变
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36518v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study a finite-state mean-field game with entropic control cost. In the large population limit, we show that its stationary Nash equilibria satisfy the detailed balance condition and their distributions take the Gibbsian form with the value function playing the role of a Hamiltonian. We apply the entropic control cost to a ferromagnetic mean-field Ising game and investigate its stationary and non-stationary Nash equilibria. We find that the stationary Nash equilibria exhibit a second-order phase transition from disordered to ordered equilibria as temperature decreases. A center-manifold reduction yields non-stationary Nash equilibrium near the critical temperature and reveals the critical slowing down in the relaxation toward the stationary Nash equilibrium.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有熵控制代价的有限状态均值场博弈。在大种群极限中，我们证明其稳定的纳什均衡满足详细的平衡条件，并且它们的分布采用吉布斯形式，其中值函数扮演汉密尔顿函数的角色。我们将熵控制成本应用于铁磁平均场Ising博弈，并研究其平稳和非平稳的NASH平衡。我们发现，随着温度的降低，固定的纳什平衡表现出从无序平衡到有序平衡的二阶相变。中心-流形还原在临界温度附近产生非平稳的纳什平衡，并显示朝向平稳纳什平衡的弛豫中的临界减速。

full_list.title_en: Determination of the Magnetic Penetration Depth from Finite-Element Susceptibility Calculations of Spheroidal and Cylindrical Superconductors
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Determination of the Magnetic Penetration Depth from Finite-Element Susceptibility Calculations of Spheroidal and Cylindrical Superconductors
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36133v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The magnetic penetration depth, λ, is a fundamental parameter of the superconducting state and is commonly determined from precision measurements of the magnetic susceptibility, χ, in the Meissner state. However, extracting λ from such measurements requires an accurate treatment of geometry-dependent demagnetization effects, for which analytic results are only available in a limited number of cases. Here we present a finite-element analysis of the magnetic response of three dimensional superconducting spheroids and cylinders with finite penetration depth. By calculating the magnetic moment and susceptibility, χ(λ), over a wide range of aspect ratios, we quantify the shape-dependent Meissner response and extract effective demagnetization factors in the λ → 0 limit. For small but finite λ, we further determine effective sample dimensions from the initial variation of χ(λ) and propose an improved analytical expression for these. Our results provide a high-precision procedure for determining λ from volume-exclusion based susceptibility measurements and should be directly applicable to the characterization of novel superconducting materials.

full_list.title_en: Dynamical quantum simulations as laboratories for quantum information
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Dynamical quantum simulations as laboratories for quantum information
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.37589v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Dynamical quantum simulations are commonly designed to access a particular response function or correlation function. Yet the underlying protocol prepares a family of many-body states that contains information well beyond the observable for which the simulation was originally designed. In this work, we explore the idea of using these states as laboratories for quantum information. As a case study, we consider the local-pulse protocols used to compute Green functions in finite XX and XXX spin chains, and we interpret opposite source rotations as encoding a classical bit into the many-body system. This allows us to follow how the resulting record propagates, how it is encoded across local subsystems, and how readily it can be accessed with different measurements. We also find a clear separation between representation and readout. While fermionic covariance data exactly reconstruct the signed response in the XX chain, simple spin measurements recover a larger fraction of the locally available information in the XXX chain. This reversed ordering persists when we move from finite-pulse discrimination to local source-angle estimation. Going beyond the source record, the same reduced states also allow us to reinterpret results in terms of Bell state recovery and quantum communication rates, as well as providing direct access to the evolving bipartite and genuine multipartite entanglement of the system. Our results show that dynamical quantum simulations developed for response calculations can naturally be used to ask a much broader set of quantum-information questions about the many-body states they already prepare.

full_list.title_en: Emergent Fermi Surfaces in Periodically Driven Bose Gases
full_list.title_zh: 周期性驱动玻色气体中的涌现费米表面
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36038v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that the steady state of a periodically driven Bose gas coupled to a thermal bath features emergent Fermi surfaces both in its high temperature and Bose-Einstein-condensate (BEC) states. These emergent Fermi surfaces are non-analyticities in the occupation function as a function of momentum arising from the lack of detailed balance of collisions away from equilibrium. They are stronger in the BEC than in the normal gas, and can be more robust against finite temperature smearing than the usual equilibrium Fermi surfaces of Fermi gases. We also show that they give rise to analogous rich phenomena, such as Friedel oscillations in the density correlations and quantum oscillations in response to applied magnetic fields controlled by their areas, albeit with marked quantitative differences. Our results establish non-equilibrium conditions as a promising alternative pathway to achieve the long-sought-after emergence of Fermi surfaces in bosonic system. We outline strategies to experimentally discover these exotic states in ultra-cold atomic clouds.

full_list.title_en: Enhancing magneto-optical coupling and scattering from magnetic vortices by optical polarization texturing
full_list.title_zh: 通过光学偏振纹理增强磁光耦合和磁涡流散射
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.37233v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic textures offer a route toward photonic functionality in which electromagnetic fields are controlled not only by material composition and geometry but also by the internal magnetic configuration. Conversely, spatial texturing of these fields is a qualitatively new tool to increase the effective coupling strength to magnetic matter and to act on the the vortex topology and magnetic dynamics. Here, we investigate the coupling and scattering of structured electromagnetic fields by a magnetic vortex, focusing on how spatially non-collinear magnetization governs polarization conversion, electromagnetic energy flow, and magnetization dynamics. We develop a spherical rigorous coupled-wave method that incorporates the spatially dependent anisotropic magnetic permeability associated with the vortex texture. The calculations show that the off-diagonal components of the magnetic susceptibility mediate conversion into complementary polarization channels that are absent from the incident field. The generated fields exhibit pronounced spatial localization associated with the vortex magnetization profile and support a nonzero azimuthal component of electromagnetic energy flow. A comparison between linearly and radially polarized illumination reveals an approximately one-order-of-magnitude difference in the scattered fields amplitudes due to polarization texturing, demonstrating the importance of spatial overlap between the incident field and the anisotropic magnetic response. The back-action on the magnetic vortex dynamics is quantitatively demonstrated by numerical simulations for the inverse Faraday effect due to the rectification of structured effective-field excitation. It is shown that polarization textured optical fields can drive vortex-core precession and, at sufficiently strong excitation, reverse the core polarity and chirality on nanosecond time scale.

full_list.title_en: Generation of quantum light with tunable Wigner negativity with a semiconductor quantum dot
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Generation of quantum light with tunable Wigner negativity with a semiconductor quantum dot
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36233v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Wigner-negative states of light are key resources for quantum advantage in continuous-variable optical quantum computing. They can be produced probabilistically via frequency conversion and photon detection, or deterministically by exploiting the single-photon nonlinearity of a quantum emitter. Here, we generate such Wigner-negative states of light with a tunable negativity using a single semiconductor quantum dot in a cavity. Optical coherent control of the quantum-dot transition allows to generate a quantum superposition of zero and one photon. The generated quantum states are characterized point-by-point in the phase space through homodyne measurement. The emergence of Wigner-function negativity is observed as the excitation power is increased. After correcting for collection and propagation losses, we obtain fidelities to the ideal state and quantum purities above 95%, together with near-optimal quadrature squeezing. The ability to generate a wide variety of Wigner-negative states with mature semiconductor technology opens promising opportunities for continuous-variable optical quantum technologies.

full_list.title_en: Kinetic Sectors and Nonequilibrium Dynamics in the δ-Ising Model
full_list.title_zh: δ-Ising 模型中的动力学部分和非平衡动力学
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36829v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce and analyze the δ-Ising model, a kinetic Ising ferromagnet in which single-spin flips are accepted when their energy change does not exceed a tunable threshold. Varying the field and threshold opens or closes local flip channels, dividing parameter space into kinetic sectors, each governed by a fixed Markov transition operator. We prove that the dynamics retains global spin-inversion symmetry exactly when up and down spins have equal numbers of open channels. In one such sector on a periodic chain of length L, unbiased random initial states therefore reach the field-aligned and antifield states with probability 1/2 each. Closing a single channel leaves both states absorbing but makes the probability of ordering against the field decay as (2/π)^L. Parameter sweeps correspond to ordered products of sector operators, which separate reaching a state from holding it, so hysteresis appears when a state is reached and released at different sector boundaries. We also show how increasing the system size can induce a Mpemba-like reversal, allowing a state with more misaligned spins to reach the final ordered state sooner on average. On a periodic chain, this reversal arises because the mean absorption time grows logarithmically with system size for many short domains but linearly for a single macroscopic domain, and it disappears when the bulk flip channel is opened. These findings show how a simple, intuitive rule for Ising dynamics links local kinetic constraints to field response, memory, and relaxation within a unified framework.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们介绍并分析了 δ-Ising 模型，这是一种动态 Ising 铁磁体，其中当能量变化不超过可调阈值时，单自旋翻转被接受。改变场和阈值会打开或关闭局部翻转通道，将参数空间划分为动力学扇区，每个扇区都由固定的马尔可夫转移算子控制。我们证明，当向上和向下自旋具有相同数量的开放通道时，动力学精确地保留了全局自旋反转对称性。因此，在长度为 L 的周期链上的一个这样的扇区中，无偏随机初始状态以各 1/2 的概率达到场对齐和反场状态。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们介绍并分析了 δ-Ising 模型，这是一种动态 Ising 铁磁体，其中当能量变化不超过可调阈值时，单自旋翻转被接受。改变场和阈值会打开或关闭局部翻转通道，将参数空间划分为动力学扇区，每个扇区都由固定的马尔可夫转移算子控制。我们证明，当向上和向下自旋具有相同数量的开放通道时，动力学精确地保留了全局自旋反转对称性。因此，在长度为 L 的周期链上的一个这样的扇区中，无偏随机初始状态以各 1/2 的概率达到场对齐和反场状态。关闭单个通道会使两种状态都吸收，但会使针对场衰减的排序概率为 (2/π)^L。参数扫描对应于扇区运算符的有序乘积，它将达到状态与保持状态分开，因此当在不同扇区边界达到和释放状态时会出现滞后。我们还展示了增加系统大小如何引发类似 Mpemba 的反转，从而允许自旋更多未对准的状态平均更快地达到最终有序状态。在周期链上，出现这种反转是因为对于许多短域，平均吸收时间随系统尺寸呈对数增长，但对于单个宏观域则呈线性增长，并且当体翻转通道打开时，这种反转就会消失。这些发现表明，伊辛动力学的简单、直观规则如何在统一的框架内将局部动力学约束与场响应、记忆和松弛联系起来。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《δ-Ising 模型中的动力学部分和非平衡动力学》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Laser-Induced 90-Degree Magnetization Switching for Single-Element 2D Sensing
full_list.title_zh: 用于单元件 2D 传感的激光诱导 90 度磁化开关
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36530v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetoresistive sensors with multiaxial sensitivity are interesting for field mapping applications where local measurement of multiple magnetic field components is needed. Existing device designs are often discretized with separate sensing elements for each vector component, or they require complex detection schemes to distinguish the different components. In this work, we showcase a single-element two-dimensional vector sensor with on-demand reprogrammable sensing axis using light and optically switchable materials. Our device is an anisotropic magnetoresistive sensor with 90^circ togglable sensitivity upon excitation with ultrashort laser pulses. The sensor consists of an optically switchable Co/Gd thin-film bilayer, patterned into a cross shape that stabilizes two orthogonal in-plane magnetization directions. By selectively addressing one diagonal of the cross, a single laser pulses toggle switches the magnetization direction in the center of the cross by 90^circ. Moreover, the field sensitivity of the device is toggled between the x- and y-axes, which we detected electrically with the planar Hall effect. Our results form a milestone towards optically reprogrammable integrated magnetic vector sensors.
full_list.abstract_zh: 具有多轴灵敏度的磁阻传感器对于需要对多个磁场分量进行本地测量的场测绘应用很有意义。现有的设备设计通常是离散的，每个矢量分量都有单独的传感元件，或者需要复杂的检测方案来区分不同的分量。在这项工作中，我们展示了一种单元件二维矢量传感器，该传感器具有使用光和光学可切换材料的按需可重新编程的传感轴。我们的设备是一种各向异性磁阻传感器，在超短激光脉冲激励下具有 90^circ 可切换灵敏度。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 具有多轴灵敏度的磁阻传感器对于需要对多个磁场分量进行本地测量的场测绘应用很有意义。现有的设备设计通常是离散的，每个矢量分量都有单独的传感元件，或者需要复杂的检测方案来区分不同的分量。在这项工作中，我们展示了一种单元件二维矢量传感器，该传感器具有使用光和光学可切换材料的按需可重新编程的传感轴。我们的设备是一种各向异性磁阻传感器，在超短激光脉冲激励下具有 90^circ 可切换灵敏度。该传感器由光学可切换的 Co/Gd 薄膜双层组成，图案化为十字形状，可稳定两个正交的面内磁化方向。通过选择性地寻址十字的一条对角线，单个激光脉冲切换将十字中心的磁化方向切换 90^circ。此外，该器件的场灵敏度在 x 轴和 y 轴之间切换，我们通过平面霍尔效应进行电检测。我们的结果构成了光学可重编程集成磁矢量传感器的里程碑。

full_list.title_en: Magnetic Imaging with High Spatial Resolution Using a Single Niobium-Nitride-Based Three-Dimensional Nanobridge Junction
full_list.title_zh: 使用单个铌氮化物基三维纳米桥结进行高空间分辨率磁成像
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36856v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The nanobridge junctions (NBJs) allow the miniaturization of the Superconducting Quantum Interference Device (SQUID) and improve the spatial resolution of scanning SQUID microscopy. However, the SQUID loop diameter imposed a fundamental limit on the resolution. In this work, we proposed a single niobium-nitride-based three-dimensional nanobridge junction (NbN-3D-NBJ) alternative to the nanoSQUID for high-resolution magnetic imaging. The critical current of an NbN-3D-NBJ showed an nearly monotonic dependence on the external magnetic field, enabling nanoscale mapping of the magnetic field distribution by measuring the junction's critical current with an intrinsic noise level of 100 nT/Hz¹/2. Using a NbN-3D-NBJ probe, we successfully imaged an Abrikosov vortex in a niobium film with a minimal full width at half maxima (FWHM) of 530 nm, constrained by the distance from the junction to the probe tip edge. Furthermore, we resolved 80 nm spacings between the superconducting nanowires utilizing a second probe with an optimized junction-to-tip distance. Thus, the single 3D NbN NBJ probe has been demonstrated as an effective approach for magnetic imaging with ultra-high spatial resolution.
full_list.abstract_zh: 纳米桥结（NBJ）可以实现超导量子干涉装置（SQUID）的小型化，并提高扫描SQUID显微镜的空间分辨率。然而，SQUID 环直径对分辨率造成了根本限制。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于铌氮化物的三维纳米桥结（NbN-3D-NBJ）替代nanoSQUID，用于高分辨率磁成像。 NbN-3D-NBJ 的临界电流对外部磁场表现出近乎单调的依赖性，通过测量固有噪声水平为 100 nT/Hz1/2 的结临界电流，可以绘制纳米级磁场分布图。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 纳米桥结（NBJ）可以实现超导量子干涉装置（SQUID）的小型化，并提高扫描SQUID显微镜的空间分辨率。然而，SQUID 环直径对分辨率造成了根本限制。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于铌氮化物的三维纳米桥结（NbN-3D-NBJ）替代nanoSQUID，用于高分辨率磁成像。 NbN-3D-NBJ 的临界电流对外部磁场表现出近乎单调的依赖性，通过测量固有噪声水平为 100 nT/Hz1/2 的结临界电流，可以绘制纳米级磁场分布图。使用 NbN-3D-NBJ 探针，我们成功地对铌薄膜中的阿布里科索夫涡旋进行了成像，最小半峰全宽 (FWHM) 为 530 nm，受到结点到探针尖端边缘距离的限制。此外，我们利用具有优化结点到尖端距离的第二个探针解决了超导纳米线之间 80 nm 的间距问题。因此，单个 3D NbN NBJ 探针已被证明是一种具有超高空间分辨率的磁成像的有效方法。

full_list.title_en: Measurement-induced entanglement phases in hyperbolic gauge-Higgs models
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Measurement-induced entanglement phases in hyperbolic gauge-Higgs models
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.36528v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Gauge-Higgs theory in flat spacetime provides a prime theoretical model of multiple phases of matter with distinct entanglement structures. More recently, there has been interest in hyperbolic space and the influence its extensive boundaries have on these structures. Entanglement transitions between non-equilibrium phases, such as topological phases, can be realized by the competition of non-commutating measurements. Here we study the entanglement phases of gauge-Higgs models on hyperbolic lattices described by measurement-only dynamics. We chart 2D phase diagrams by employing topological entanglement entropy and introducing a generalized measurement-induced entanglement tailored for hyperbolic Higgs phases. Utilizing duality, we find a phase absent in Euclidean space, wherein the bulk lattice hosts separated clusters of symmetry-protected topological order. Transitions between this "archipelago" phase and neighboring topological and trivial phases feature a critical exponent δ belonging to a mean-field universality class. Our essential tool is a 3D resource state inspired by measurement-based quantum computation that simulates the spacetime evolution of the 2D quantum state with a third direction of entanglement. This allows us to analyze spacetime "sponges" of entanglement, which map to classical percolation theory and allow us to infer values of critical points on our phase diagrams' boundaries.

full_list.title_en: Metamagnetic ripples in the UTe2 high magnetic field phase diagram
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Metamagnetic ripples in the UTe2 high magnetic field phase diagram
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2503.11362v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The heavy fermion metamagnet uranium ditelluride possesses two distinct magnetic field-induced superconducting states. One of these superconductive phases resides at magnetic fields immediately below a first-order metamagnetic transition to a field-polarized paramagnetic state at a field strength Hₘ, while the other exists predominantly above Hₘ. However, little is known about the microscopic properties of this polarized paramagnetic state. Here we report pulsed magnetic field measurements tracking the evolution of Hₘ for polar and azimuthal inclinations of the magnetic field in the vicinity of the crystallographic b-a plane. We uncover a region of the phase diagram at high fields > 50 T with a ripple-like non-monotonic dependence of Hₘ on the orientation of field. Within this ripple in the metamagnetic transition surface, Hₘ exhibits an anomalous temperature dependence, implying that here the polarized state has a lower entropy than the low field paramagnetic state. Our results point towards the presence of complex magnetic interactions and possible magnetic sub-phases at high magnetic fields in UTe₂, which may have important implications for the manifestation of exotic field-induced superconductivity.

core_items.title_en: Sustainability-Aware Discovery of Dual-Atom Hydrogen Evolution Catalysts via a Unified Machine Learning Framework for Activity and Carbon Cost
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：Sustainability-Aware Discovery of Dual-Atom Hydrogen Evolution Catalysts via a Unified Machine Learning Framework for Activity and Carbon Cost
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2605.29821v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Catalyst discovery for green hydrogen has optimized activity alone, deferring economic and environmental costs to stages where they disqualify otherwise promising candidates. Here we introduce a unified machine learning framework that screens catalytic activity and monetized carbon cost in a single pipeline. A machine learning potential predicts hydrogen evolution activity and stability at density-functional-theory accuracy. A second model, trained on published estimates of the social cost of carbon, converts each candidate's embodied CO2 into a monetary burden. Screening 460 graphene-supported dual-atom catalysts across 23 transition metals and 20 nitrogen-coordination motifs yields 26 active, synthesizable candidates. The two axes then conflict. The most active candidates span Mn-, Fe-, Zr-, Cr-, Cu-, Ni-, Ti-, Nb-, V-, Pd-, Au-, and Rh-based catalysts, indistinguishable in adsorption energy yet spanning a 58,000-fold range in carbon cost. Joint optimization selects Mn2@2Nf and Zr2@2Nc, matching the best precious-metal activity at tens-of-thousands-fold lower carbon cost, independent of catalyst loading.

core_items.title_en: Robust high-fidelity three-qubit gates design for superconducting quantum computers via model-free reinforcement learning
core_items.title_zh: 通过无模型强化学习为超导量子计算机设计鲁棒的高保真三量子位门
core_items.abstract: Multi-qubit gates are crucial to realizing quantum algorithms. Direct implementation of these gates will facilitate a reduction in circuit depth. However, existing model-based methods rely on precise characterization of the system Hamiltonian as well as execution of the control fields, which present challenges in obtaining high fidelity multi-qubit gates. In this paper, we exploit the bang–bang control protocol and model-free reinforcement learning to realize several kinds of three-qubit gates for superconducting quantum computers with tunable/fixed frequency qubits, including the iToffoli gate, the parity check gate and the CCZ gate. The simulation results show that the fidelity of each gate can achieve 99.2% with the Adam gradient descent optimizer. Moreover, the proposed method is robust against random noise in the control pulse. Gate fidelity can be maintained over 95% even in the case of Gaussian noise with variance of 0.3. Besides, the impacts of parameter iterative optimization strategies are also analyzed.
core_items.abstract_zh: 多量子位门对于实现量子算法至关重要。直接实现这些门将有助于减少电路深度。然而，现有的基于模型的方法依赖于系统哈密顿量的精确表征以及控制场的执行，这对获得高保真多量子位门提出了挑战。在本文中，我们利用bang-bang控制协议和无模型强化学习，为具有可调谐/固定频率量子位的超导量子计算机实现了几种三量子位门，包括iToffoli门、奇偶校验门和CCZ门。仿真结果表明，采用Adam梯度下降优化器，每个门的保真度可以达到99.2%。

core_items.title_en: Physical structure as an organizing principle for universal Hamiltonian learning
core_items.title_zh: 物理结构作为通用哈密顿学习的组织原则
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.36135v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Density functional theory (DFT) gives the electronic structure of materials, but its cost limits large-supercell calculations and materials screening. Machine-learned Hamiltonians bypass the self-consistent cycle but are usually system-specific; universal ones could cover new compositions and disordered solids. Such models must generalize across chemistry and keep downstream properties physical, while staying inexpensive for large cells. Here we introduce UniTB, a universal E(3) equivariant Hamiltonian representation framework that integrates physical priors rooted in density-functional tight-binding theory with deep learning. UniTB's network, which corrects a prior Hamiltonian, generalizes across chemistry through a mixture of experts routed by that prior and a charge-equilibration head as in self-consistent-charge tight binding. A projection bounds band shifts from the prior, suppressing spurious states and keeping downstream properties physical. We provide the fastest SO(2) tensor-product GPU kernels for the network. The variant UniTB-Flash assembles its prior from two-center tables at O(N) cost for N atoms, against O(Nlog N) on a grid. Trained on 29,242 crystals, UniTB reaches a 0.48 meV matrix-element error on nonmagnetic test crystals spanning 68 elements. Without amorphous training data, both models agree with DFT optics and conductivity of amorphous Ge-Sb-Te. UniTB-Flash ranks candidates with no significant difference from UniTB, whose property values are more accurate; together they screen 16,195 crystals for five application domains of industrial relevance.
core_items.abstract_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）给出了材料的电子结构，但其成本限制了大型超晶胞计算和材料筛选。机器学习的哈密顿量绕过了自洽循环，但通常是特定于系统的；通用的可以涵盖新的组合物和无序固体。此类模型必须能够推广到整个化学领域，并保持下游物理特性，同时保持大电池的廉价性。在这里，我们介绍 UniTB，一个通用的 E(3) 等变哈密顿表示框架，它将植根于密度泛函紧束缚理论的物理先验与深度学习相结合。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 密度泛函理论（DFT）给出了材料的电子结构，但其成本限制了大型超晶胞计算和材料筛选。机器学习的哈密顿量绕过了自洽循环，但通常是特定于系统的；通用的可以涵盖新的组合物和无序固体。此类模型必须能够推广到整个化学领域，并保持下游物理特性，同时保持大电池的廉价性。在这里，我们介绍 UniTB，一个通用的 E(3) 等变哈密顿表示框架，它将植根于密度泛函紧束缚理论的物理先验与深度学习相结合。 UniTB 的网络纠正了先前的哈密顿量，通过由先前的哈密顿量和电荷平衡头路由的专家混合来概括整个化学，就像自洽电荷紧密结合一样。投影限制了先前的能带偏移，抑制了杂散状态并保持了下游特性的物理性。我们为网络提供最快的 SO(2) 张量积 GPU 内核。变体 UniTB-Flash 以 N 原子的 O(N) 成本从两个中心表组装其先验，相对于网格上的 O(Nlog N)。在 29,242 个晶体上进行训练后，UniTB 在跨越 68 个元件的非磁性测试晶体上达到了 0.48 meV 矩阵元件误差。在没有非晶训练数据的情况下，两个模型都符合非晶 Ge-Sb-Te 的 DFT 光学和电导率。 UniTB-Flash对候选者进行排名与UniTB没有显着差异，其属性值更准确；他们共同筛选了 16,195 种晶体，用于五个工业相关应用领域。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：等变神经网络与对称性保持表示, 密度泛函理论和电子结构计算, 有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《物理结构作为通用哈密顿学习的组织原则》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Charge density-supervised real-space representations for atomistic energy prediction
core_items.title_zh: 用于原子能量预测的电荷密度监督实空间表示
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.36779v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ground-state electron density contains sufficient information to determine ground-state energy, while providing spatial electronic information. This study developed a charge-density-informed graph neural network (hereafter CDGNN) that jointly learns energy and valence electron density from equivariant atomic graphs. This approach incorporates density-supervised real-space probe representations into the global energy regressor, allowing density-related spatial information to contribute to energy prediction. On the QM9 dataset, CDGNN reduced the energy prediction errors relative to an equivariant GNN baseline for interpolation and extrapolation to larger molecules. For small H-containing Fe and Fe-C datasets, CDGNN performed similarly to the baseline, indicating the dataset-dependent benefits of density supervision. CDGNN also accurately predicted the charge density distributions for molecular and Fe-based systems. The attention analysis showed higher weights for probe representations near the H atoms in Fe-based structures. These findings highlight the potential of integrating charge-density information for energy prediction and its task-dependent benefits.
core_items.abstract_zh: 基态电子密度包含足够的信息来确定基态能量，同时提供空间电子信息。这项研究开发了一种电荷密度信息图神经网络（以下简称 CDGNN），它从等变原子图中联合学习能量和价电子密度。这种方法将密度监督的真实空间探针表示合并到全局能量回归器中，允许与密度相关的空间信息有助于能量预测。在 QM9 数据集上，CDGNN 相对于等变 GNN 基线减少了能量预测误差，用于对较大分子进行插值和外推。

core_items.title_en: Machine learning enabled design of sustainable alloys considering real world constraints
core_items.title_zh: 机器学习支持考虑现实世界限制的可持续合金设计
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.35946v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Designing sustainable alloys must reconcile high performance with real-world constraints, including feedstock scarcity and variability, processing and energy requirements, regulatory thresholds, and economic limitations. Addressing these constraints reaches far beyond today's conventional performance-focused frameworks. It needs to consider not only complex property-processing-performance trade-offs but also sustainable production pathways. Here, we propose a physics-informed ensemble (PIE) learning framework that integrates fundamental structure-property relationships with processing routes and sustainability criteria for mechanism-based alloy design. It predicts properties from composition-microstructure relationships and infers processing routes under sustainability constraints, establishing an interdisciplinary approach to identifying sustainable alloy solutions. We validate the approach for Mg alloys, a lightweight yet energy-intensive metallic material class, considering performance, cost, and carbon emissions. Trained on a benchmark dataset, the PIE model systematically explores plausible alloy compositions and microstructures to construct a digital library of millions of candidate alloys. From this space, we identify two sustainable Mg alloy solutions that overcome the conventional performance-cost-emission trade-off: a rare-earth-containing alloy increases yield and tensile strength by 72.8 percent and 61.1 percent, respectively, over alloys from the same family at comparable cost and emissions; and a rare-earth-free alloy reduces cost and carbon emissions by 40.4 percent and 88.9 percent, respectively, relative to its primary-feedstock counterpart, without compromising mechanical performance. This work introduces a general, physics-informed, and quantifiable framework for designing sustainable alloys under real-world constraints.
core_items.abstract_zh: 设计可持续合金必须协调高性能与现实世界的限制，包括原料稀缺性和可变性、加工和能源要求、监管阈值和经济限制。解决这些限制远远超出了当今传统的以性能为中心的框架的范围。它不仅需要考虑复杂的财产-加工-性能权衡，还需要考虑可持续的生产途径。在这里，我们提出了一种物理信息集成（PIE）学习框架，它将基本结构-性能关系与基于机制的合金设计的加工路线和可持续性标准相结合。它根据成分-微观结构关系预测性能，并推断可持续性约束下的加工路线，建立跨学科方法来识别可持续合金解决方案。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 设计可持续合金必须协调高性能与现实世界的限制，包括原料稀缺性和可变性、加工和能源要求、监管阈值和经济限制。解决这些限制远远超出了当今传统的以性能为中心的框架的范围。它不仅需要考虑复杂的财产-加工-性能权衡，还需要考虑可持续的生产途径。在这里，我们提出了一种物理信息集成（PIE）学习框架，它将基本结构-性能关系与基于机制的合金设计的加工路线和可持续性标准相结合。它根据成分-微观结构关系预测性能，并推断可持续性约束下的加工路线，建立跨学科方法来识别可持续合金解决方案。我们验证了镁合金（一种轻质但能源密集型金属材料类别）的方法，同时考虑了性能、成本和碳排放。 PIE 模型在基准数据集上进行训练，系统地探索合理的合金成分和微观结构，以构建包含数百万种候选合金的数字库。从这个领域，我们确定了两种可持续的镁合金解决方案，克服了传统的性能-成本-排放权衡：与成本和排放相当的同类合金相比，含稀土合金的产量和抗拉强度分别提高了 72.8% 和 61.1%；与主要原料相比，不含稀土的合金可分别降低成本和碳排放 40.4% 和 88.9%，且不会影响机械性能。这项工作介绍了一个通用的、基于物理的、可量化的框架，用于在现实世界的限制下设计可持续合金。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对《机器学习支持考虑现实世界限制的可持续合金设计》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Attention as Lattice Gauge Theory: Relations Interact Only Through Wilson Loops
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：Attention as Lattice Gauge Theory: Relations Interact Only Through Wilson Loops
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.37656v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Relations compose through the entity they share - Alice is Bob's mother and Bob is Carol's father, so Alice is Carol's grandmother - and the order matters, since a father's mother is not a mother's father; verifying a composed relation means closing the loop. We show that if each entity's coordinate frame may be rotated independently (per-entity frame freedom), three things follow. In the pure-gauge sector, relations that share no cycle cannot interact at all. The only gauge-invariant score of a triangle is a class function of its holonomy H = Tᵢⱼ Tⱼₖ Tₖᵢ - a Wilson loop. And the only equivariant update of an edge is U = Ψ(H), Tᵢⱼ with Ψ conjugation-equivariant. Edge attention by Wilson loops is therefore not one design among many but the unique form the symmetry permits. Three communities hold pieces of this form: the commuting-operator embeddings of knowledge graphs are its abelian (commuting) sector; AlphaFold's triangle update and the Edge Transformer have its shape - an edge updated through the third vertex - without its constraints; and lattice QCD builds it equivariantly on lattices. We instantiate the equivariant sub-family on general relational graphs as holonomy attention. With no training and composition alone, it infers unobserved S₄ relations on sparse graphs at 0.88 with a fifth of the edges corrupted, at or slightly below specialist synchronization algorithms, where every commutative architecture is capped at 0.083; its holonomy score flags corrupted triangles at AUC 0.99 where commuting scores are capped at 0.76 by a second selection rule, and it separates clusters without labels.

core_items.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：等变神经网络与对称性保持表示。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对《Attention as Lattice Gauge Theory: Relations Interact Only Through Wilson Loops》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Back-End-Of-Line Integration of 2-Terminal Ferroelectric Hafnia Synaptic Weights on Commercial CMOS Process
core_items.title_zh: 商用 CMOS 工艺上 2 端子铁电 Hafnia 突触权重的后端集成
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.37530v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Functionalising the back-end-of-line (BEOL) of CMOS with emerging materials is a key route to neural network accelerators and neuromorphic systems. In this work, we demonstrate for the first time the integration of 2-terminal ferroelectric synaptic weights in the BEOL of as-delivered commercial 180 nm CMOS dies. A novel material stack is proposed, in which a WOx/[HfO2-ZrO2] bilayer is sandwiched between TiN and Mo electrodes. For devices annealed at 450 degC, programming below 1.8 V is achieved with a cycle-to-cycle variation below 3 %. Synaptic weights annealed at 500 degC exhibit more gradual weight updates, while the tested underlying NMOS transistors remain functional after the complete integration process. The trade-off between thermal budget and on-device training performance is illustrated using hardware-aware neural network simulations.
core_items.abstract_zh: 用新兴材料功能化CMOS的后端（ BEOL ）是神经网络加速器和神经形态系统的关键途径。在这项工作中，我们首次演示了在交付的商用180纳米CMOS模具的BEOL中集成2端铁电突触重量。提出了一种新型材料堆叠，其中WOx/[HfO2-ZrO2]双层夹在TiN和Mo电极之间。对于在450 ℃退火的器件，以低于3 ％的周期间变化实现低于1.8 V的编程。在500 ℃退火的突触重量表现出更多的渐进重量更新，而经过测试的底层NMOS晶体管在完成集成过程后仍保持功能。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 用新兴材料功能化CMOS的后端（ BEOL ）是神经网络加速器和神经形态系统的关键途径。在这项工作中，我们首次演示了在交付的商用180纳米CMOS模具的BEOL中集成2端铁电突触重量。提出了一种新型材料堆叠，其中WOx/[HfO2-ZrO2]双层夹在TiN和Mo电极之间。对于在450 ℃退火的器件，以低于3 ％的周期间变化实现低于1.8 V的编程。在500 ℃退火的突触重量表现出更多的渐进重量更新，而经过测试的底层NMOS晶体管在完成集成过程后仍保持功能。使用硬件感知神经网络模拟说明了热预算和设备上训练性能之间的权衡。
core_items.summary: 用新兴材料功能化CMOS的后端（ BEOL ）是神经网络加速器和神经形态系统的关键途径。在这项工作中，我们首次演示了在交付的商用180纳米CMOS模具的BEOL中集成2端铁电突触重量。提出了一种新型材料堆叠，其中WOx/[HfO2-ZrO2]双层夹在TiN和Mo电极之间。对于在450 ℃退火的器件，以低于3 ％的周期间变化实现低于1.8 V的编程。在500 ℃退火的突触重量表现出更多的渐进重量更新，而经过测试的底层NMOS晶体管在完成集成过程后仍保持功能。
core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《商用 CMOS 工艺上 2 端子铁电 Hafnia 突触权重的后端集成》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。
